content.text:
对，确实不好。分析一下：

| 当前 RQ 名 | 问题 |
|-----------|------|
| RQ1: "Does Semantic Profiling Separate What Flat Views Mix?" | "Separate What Flat Views Mix" 嵌套从句很绕，"flat views" 和 "mix" 是论文内部术语，读者看标题不知道在问什么 |
| RQ2: "Can Profiler Groups Localize Hidden Labeled Problems?" | "Hidden Labeled Problems" 是**评估方法**的描述，不是**读者关心的问题**。读者关心的是"profiler 输出有没有用"，不是"能不能定位隐藏标签" |
| RQ3: "How Reliable Are the Derived Labels?" | 还行，但 "derived labels" 不够直观——derived from what? |

**RQ 名字的原则：** 用读者关心的问题命名，不是用你的方法论命名。读者扫一眼 subsection 标题就该知道这节回答什么。

建议：

| 改后 | 读者立刻理解 |
|------|------------|
| RQ1: Does Semantic Profiling Add Information Beyond Flat Counters? | "加了语义标签后能多看到什么？" |
| RQ2: Does Profiler Output Correspond to Real Problems? | "profiler 排出来的东西是不是真问题？" |
| RQ3: How Accurate Are the Assigned Labels? | "给的标签对不对？" |

或者更简洁：

| 更短版 | |
|-------|---|
| RQ1: What Does Semantic Profiling Reveal? | |
| RQ2: Do Top-Ranked Groups Contain Real Problems? | |
| RQ3: How Accurate Are the Labels? | |

你倾向哪种风格？还是你有更好的想法？

24	\title{AgentProf: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}
25	
26	\begin{abstract}
27	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities across hundreds of
28	sessions, but existing observability tools provide only per-session
29	debugging views with no cross-session profiling layer.
30	% AI 智能体跨数百个会话编排多步骤活动，但现有可观测性工具仅提供按会话的调试视图，没有跨会话的 profiling 层。
31	To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need
32	aggregate analysis of which task categories consume the most budget,
33	where failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe
34	side-effects, but today the only option is manual inspection of
35	individual sessions.

37	We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} that adapts the
38	flame-graph methodology to agent traces: uniform \emph{semantic
39	operations} represent all activities, \emph{intent attribution}
40	derives deterministic labels from natural-language fields, and
41	\emph{profile projections} construct aggregation hierarchies from
42	field selections at query time.
43	% 我们提出一个语义 profiling 模型，将火焰图方法论适配到智能体 trace：统一的语义 operation 表示所有活动，意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性标签，profile 投影在查询时从字段选择构造聚合层次。
44	\sys implements this model as a profiler that compiles local agent
45	traces into pprof-compatible profiles with pluggable
46	intent-attribution backends.
47	% \sys 将此模型实现为一个 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile，支持可插拔的意图归因后端。
48	On 325 real agent sessions, semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
49	system-effect weight that session-level views merge.
50	% 在 325 个真实智能体会话上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
51	On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
52	(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
53	problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
54	fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
55	% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。

61	\section{Introduction}
62	\label{sec:intro}
63	
64	%% ¶1: Background + context
65	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
66	layers: high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
67	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
68	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
69	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
70	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
71	over weeks or months.
72	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
73	
74	%% ¶2: Problem
75	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
76	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions to determine
77	which categories of tasks consume the most token budget, where
78	failures concentrate across workflows, and which behavioral patterns
79	trigger unsafe system side-effects.
80	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
81	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
82	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
83	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析——profiling——与单次执行调试区分开来。
84	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
85	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
86	
87	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
88	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
89	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
90	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
91	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
92	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
93	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
94	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
95	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
96	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
97	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
98	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
99	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
100	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
101	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
102	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
103	
104	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
105	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
106	software.
107	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
108	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
109	single chart where width represents cost.
110	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
111	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
112	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
113	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
114	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
115	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
116	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
117	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
118	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
119	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
120	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
121	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
122	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
123	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
124	function calls produce stack frames.
125	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
126	
127	%% ¶5: Model
128	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
129	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
130	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
131	traces.
132	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
133	We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
134	% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
135	\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
136	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
137	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
138	objects.
139	% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
140	\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
141	labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
142	precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
143	% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
144	\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
145	time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
146	stack.
147	% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
148	Different field selections answer different questions---by task
149	category, by execution phase, by session, by action type---from the
150	same data.
151	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。
152	
153	%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
154	We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
155	local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles
156	(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
157	% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。

% Table~\ref{tab:vmeasure} 和 Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} 展示了结果。
On 7/9 datasets, V-measure exceeds 0.7, indicating strong agreement between mapping-derived and native labels.
% 在 7/9 数据集上，V-measure 超过 0.7，表明映射衍生标签与原生标签之间有很强的一致性。
The two low-scoring datasets (toolbench, api-bank) have atypical action vocabularies that the held-out mapping rules do not cover.
% 两个低分数据集（toolbench、api-bank）具有保留映射规则未覆盖的非典型操作词汇。

On datasets with boundary annotations, supervised predictors beat simple baselines on 4/5 families (e.g., F1~0.77 vs 0.71 on OSWorld-Human), confirming that mapping rules produce useful labels but are not automatic intent discovery.
% 在有边界标注的数据集上，有监督预测器在 4/5 家族上超过简单基线（例如 OSWorld-Human 上 F1 约 0.77 vs 0.71），确认映射规则产生有用标签但不是自动意图发现。

All results are backed by profile specs for deterministic replay.
% 所有结果都有 profile spec 支持确定性重放。
We re-execute 76 tracked specs twice (152 invocations), and all produce identical output with median runtime 1.6\,s per spec.
% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 spec 两次（152 次调用），全部产生相同输出，中位运行时间每 spec 1.6 秒。
The full profile-spec composition path (operation files, query predicates, rank rules, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested configuration variants.
% 完整的 profile spec 组合路径（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名规则和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试的配置变体中保持确定性。

## Eval 当前问题 & 建议改动清单

### 1. RQ 标题用了内部方法论术语，不是读者关心的问题

| 当前 | 问题 | 建议 |
|------|------|------|
| RQ1: "Does Semantic Profiling Separate What Flat Views Mix?" | "Separate What Flat Views Mix" 嵌套从句，"flat views" 和 "mix" 是内部概念 | → "What Does Semantic Profiling Reveal?" 或 "Does Semantic Labeling Add Information?" |
| RQ2: "Can Profiler Groups Localize Hidden Labeled Problems?" | "Hidden Labeled Problems" 是评估方法描述，不是读者关心的 | → "Does Profiler Output Correspond to Real Problems?" |
| RQ3: "How Reliable Are the Derived Labels?" | "derived labels" 不直观 | → "How Accurate Are the Labels?" |

### 2. RQ2 后半段过长且偏离核心问题（~20 行）

RQ2 核心是"profiler 输出能不能对应真实问题"，但后半段混入了三块次要内容：

| 段落 | 行数 | 内容 | 问题 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 配置改进 (L732-742) | 11 行 | 5/6 patches improve AP, 三种 patterns, OSWorld boundary | 回答的是"配置旋钮有没有用"，不是"能不能定位"。且 OSWorld boundary 在 RQ3 重复出现 |
| 排名特征消融 (L745-748) | 4 行 | 7 有用特征 3 误导，手动修正 2/3 | 太细节，repeat\_signal / write-action 未定义，读者不知道这些是什么 |

**建议：** 配置改进压缩为 2 行总结（"5/6 配置变更改进 AP"），删除三种 patterns 展开和 OSWorld 具体数据。排名特征消融整段删除。

### 3. RQ3 边界预测器段落与 RQ2 重复（~8 行）

| 段落 | 行数 | 内容 | 问题 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 边界预测器 (L817-824) | 8 行 | supervised predictor F1 0.77, 4/5 baselines, repeat-signal | 引入了一个全新子实验但只 8 行展开不够深入；OSWorld-Human boundary 与 RQ2 L740-742 重复 |

**建议：** 压缩为 1-2 行（"supervised predictors beat baselines on 4/5 families, confirming labels are useful but not automatic"）。

### 4. R405 意图识别质量缺口原因缺失

| 当前 | 问题 |
|------|------|
| "Quality assessment...remains future work." (L762) | 只说了"future work"，没解释**为什么**——读者/reviewer 会追问"为什么不做？" |

**建议：** 加一句解释原因："because none of the available oracle-rich datasets simultaneously expose free-form text fields and hidden semantic labels"。这把"没做到"变成"数据结构限制使其不可行"，reviewers 更容易接受。

### 5. Eval 开头 metric 列表（L510）定义不够

| 当前 | 问题 |
|------|------|
| "We measure semantic separation (mixed-weight percentage), localization quality (AP, recall, work-to-first-positive), and label agreement (V-measure, boundary F1)." | 括号里的缩写在这里首次出现但只给了全称，读者不知道具体含义 |

**建议：** 这里保持简洁没问题，但要确保每个 metric 在对应 RQ 节**首次使用时**有 1 句定义。目前 AP 和 WTFP 只在 Table 4 caption 定义，正文没有。RQ1 的 "mixed-weight percentage" 在 L550-551 有解释。

---

| 改动 | 节省行数 | 价值 |
|------|---------|------|
| RQ 标题改名 | 0 | 读者一眼看懂 |
| RQ2 配置改进段落压缩 | ~9 行 | 去掉偏题内容 |
| RQ2 排名特征消融删除 | ~4 行 | 去掉未定义 jargon |
| RQ3 边界预测器压缩 | ~6 行 | 去掉重复 |
| R405 原因补充 | +1 行 | 堵住 reviewer 追问 |
| **净节省** | **~18 行** | 可能从 8 页降回 7 页 |

777	% 我们运行留一数据集评估。
778	For each of 9 datasets, we train mapping rules on the other 8 and measure V-measure between the mapping-derived \texttt{phase} field and the dataset's native \texttt{action} labels, plus boundary F1 between mapped phase boundaries and native action boundaries.
779	% 对于 9 个数据集中的每一个，我们在其余 8 个上训练映射规则，测量映射衍生的 \texttt{phase} 字段与数据集原生 \texttt{action} 标签之间的 V-measure，以及映射阶段边界与原生操作边界之间的边界 F1。
780	
781	\begin{table}[t]
782	\centering\small
783	\caption{Leave-dataset-out mapping quality. V-measure between
784	mapping-derived \texttt{phase} and native \texttt{action} labels.
785	13{,}265 operations from the four oracle-rich families
786	across 9 held-out evaluations.}
787	\label{tab:vmeasure}
788	\begin{tabular}{lrrr}
789	\toprule
790	Held-out dataset & Ops & V-measure & Boundary F1 \\
791	\midrule
792	mind2web & 774 & 1.000 & 1.000 \\
793	webshop-expert & 2{,}504 & 1.000 & 1.000 \\
794	swe-agent & 496 & 0.926 & 0.962 \\
795	weblinx-chat & 500 & 0.872 & 0.860 \\
796	agenttrek & 200 & 0.862 & --- \\
797	gui-odyssey & 7{,}868 & 0.811 & 0.842 \\
798	android-control & 9 & 0.716 & 0.727 \\
799	toolbench & 866 & 0.134 & 0.353 \\
800	api-bank & 48 & 0.000 & --- \\
801	\bottomrule
802	\end{tabular}
803	\end{table}
804	
805	\begin{figure}[t]
806	\centering
807	\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/fig-rq3-vmeasure.pdf}
808	\caption{RQ3: Leave-dataset-out V-measure between mapping-derived
809	\texttt{phase} and native \texttt{action} labels. The dashed line
810	marks 0.7. Seven of nine datasets exceed this threshold.}
811	\Description{Bar chart showing V-measure for nine held-out datasets,
812	with a dashed line at 0.7.}
813	\label{fig:rq3-vmeasure}
814	\end{figure}
815	
816	Table~\ref{tab:vmeasure} and Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} show the results.
817	% Table~\ref{tab:vmeasure} 和 Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} 展示了结果。
818	On 7/9 datasets, V-measure exceeds 0.7, indicating strong agreement between mapping-derived and native labels.
819	% 在 7/9 数据集上，V-measure 超过 0.7，表明映射衍生标签与原生标签之间有很强的一致性。
820	The two low-scoring datasets (toolbench, api-bank) have atypical action vocabularies that the held-out mapping rules do not cover.
821	% 两个低分数据集（toolbench、api-bank）具有保留映射规则未覆盖的非典型操作词汇。
822	
823	A supervised boundary predictor further validates the mapping approach.
824	% 有监督的边界预测器进一步验证了映射方法。
825	On OSWorld-Human held-out adjacent pairs, a learned boundary predictor achieves F1~0.77, beating the best simple baseline (\texttt{always\_boundary}, F1~0.71).
826	% 在 OSWorld-Human 保留相邻对上，学习的边界预测器达到 F1 约 0.77，超过最佳简单基线（\texttt{always\_boundary}，F1 约 0.71）。
827	Learned predictors beat simple baselines on 4/5 tested datasets, while AgentRewardBench looping is fully explained by a single repeat-signal feature (baseline F1~1.0).
828	% 学习预测器在 4/5 测试的数据集上超过简单基线，而 AgentRewardBench 循环完全由单个重复信号特征解释（基线 F1 约 1.0）。
829	These comparisons confirm that mapping rules produce useful labels but are not automatic intent discovery.
830	% 这些比较确认映射规则产生有用的标签，但不是自动意图发现。
831	
832	%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
833	\subsection{RQ4: What Is the Profiling Cost?}
834	% RQ4：分析开销是多少？
835	
836	\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler, so it adds zero overhead to the agent's runtime.
837	% \sys 是离线事后分析器，对智能体运行时不增加任何开销。
838	The profiling cost is the time and resources spent after the session ends.
839	% 分析开销是会话结束后花费的时间和资源。
840	
841	We re-execute 76 tracked profile specs twice (152 invocations) to measure cost and verify determinism.
842	% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 profile spec 两次（152 次调用）来测量开销并验证确定性。
843	All 76 specs produce byte-identical output across both runs.
844	% 全部 76 个 spec 在两次运行中产生字节相同的输出。
845	Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per spec (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
846	% 中位分析时间为每 spec 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
847	The slowest specs process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness-check specs all complete within 1.6\,s.
848	% 最慢的 spec 处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性检查 spec 全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
849	The full profile-spec composition path (operation files, query predicates, rank rules, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested configuration variants.
850	% 完整的 profile spec 组合路径（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名规则和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试的配置变体中保持确定性。
851	
852	Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
853	% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
854	Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real sessions, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per label using a local 3B-parameter model.
855	% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
856	Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test labels).
857	% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
858	Because labels are cached, re-profiling the same sessions with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
859	% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。
860	
861	%% ===================================================================
862	\section{Related Work}
863	% 相关工作
864	
865	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} establish the folded-stack lineage.
866	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 建立了折叠栈的谱系。
867	Profiles are weighted samples with location hierarchies.
868	% 概要是带有位置层次的加权样本。
869	Pprof supports sample labels and can visualize them as pseudo stack frames through tag-root/tag-leaf options.
870	% Pprof 支持样本标签，并可通过 tag-root/tag-leaf 选项将其可视化为伪栈帧。
871	Perfetto generalizes trace ingestion with SQL-based analysis and derived events~\cite{perfetto}.
872	% Perfetto 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件~\cite{perfetto}泛化了 trace 摄取。
873	These systems support query-time aggregation, so \sys does not claim novelty for flexible aggregation alone.
874	% 这些系统支持查询时聚合，因此 \sys 不单独声称灵活聚合的新颖性。
875	The difference is structural.
876	% 差异是结构性的。
877	Pprof's tagroot adds label-derived frames to an existing execution call stack.
878	% Pprof 的 tagroot 在已有执行调用栈上添加标签衍生帧。
879	Agent traces have no execution stack, so the entire profiling structure must be constructed from semantic fields.
880	% 智能体 trace 没有执行栈，因此整个分析结构必须从语义字段构建。
881	The evaluation also differs: \sys scores profiler output against hidden agent-trajectory labels, a methodology with no analogue in CPU profiling.
882	% 评估也不同：\sys 将分析器输出与隐藏的智能体轨迹标签进行评分，这一方法在 CPU 分析中没有对应物。
883	
884	OpenTelemetry GenAI and OpenInference standardize GenAI spans~\cite{otel, openinference}.
885	% OpenTelemetry GenAI 和 OpenInference 标准化了 GenAI span~\cite{otel, openinference}。
886	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}, and Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} provide trace visualization, session management, evaluations, and dashboards.
887	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse} 和 Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 提供 trace 可视化、会话管理、评估和仪表盘。
888	AgentOps~\cite{agentops} argues for structured agent observability covering goals, plans, tools, and artifacts.
889	% AgentOps~\cite{agentops} 主张涵盖目标、计划、工具和制品的结构化智能体可观测性。
890	AgentTelemetry~\cite{agenttelemetry} defines 14 fault types over 9 agent-specific span kinds that extend OpenTelemetry for agent orchestration phases.
891	% AgentTelemetry~\cite{agenttelemetry} 定义了 9 种智能体特定 span 类型上的 14 种故障类型，扩展了 OpenTelemetry 以覆盖智能体编排阶段。
892	Wang et al.~\cite{agenttraces-trust} survey evidence tracing and execution provenance as foundations for agent accountability.
893	% Wang et al.~\cite{agenttraces-trust} 综述了证据追踪和执行溯源作为智能体问责的基础。
894	These systems excel at single-execution debugging or fault detection.
895	% 这些系统擅长单次执行调试或故障检测。
896	\sys complements them with cross-session aggregate profiling.
897	% \sys 以跨会话聚合分析作为补充。

\section{Evaluation}
% 评估
\label{sec:eval}

We use two classes of data.
% 我们使用两类数据。
\emph{Real agent sessions}: 325 readable local sessions (198~Codex, 50~Claude, 77~Claude subagent) from a multi-month development project, containing 183{,}714 system observations.
% 真实智能体会话：来自一个多月开发项目的 325 个可读本地会话（198 个 Codex、50 个 Claude、77 个 Claude 子智能体），包含 183,714 个系统观测。
\emph{Public labeled traces}: 15 families covering web, mobile, desktop, software, API, and dialogue agents (Table~\ref{tab:datasets}), totaling 47{,}590 operations through mapping rules.
% 公开标注 trace：15 个家族，涵盖 web、移动、桌面、软件、API 和对话智能体（Table~\ref{tab:datasets}），通过映射规则共计 47,590 个 operation。
All public traces are real agent or human executions collected and labeled by their respective benchmark projects.
% 所有公开 trace 都是由各自基准项目收集和标注的真实智能体或人类执行。
Four oracle-rich families (AgentRewardBench, SATraj-OS, AgentNet, OSWorld-Human) provide hidden ground-truth labels for RQ2.
% 四个 oracle 丰富的家族（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet、OSWorld-Human）为 RQ2 提供隐藏的真实标签。
We measure semantic separation (mixed-weight percentage), localization quality (AP, recall, work-to-first-positive), and label agreement (V-measure, boundary F1).
% 我们测量语义分离度（混合权重百分比）、定位质量（AP、召回率、首个正例工作量）和标签一致性（V-measure、边界 F1）。

\begin{table*}[t]
\centering\small
\caption{Public labeled trace families. All traces are real agent or
human executions. The bottom four rows provide oracle labels for RQ2.}
\label{tab:datasets}
\begin{tabular}{p{0.17\linewidth}p{0.22\linewidth}p{0.15\linewidth}p{0.17\linewidth}p{0.17\linewidth}}
\toprule
Family & Native labels & Access & Trace origin & Eval.\ role \\
\midrule
WebLINX~\cite{weblinx}, Mind2Web~\cite{mind2web}, AgentTrek~\cite{agenttrek}, WebShop~\cite{webshop} & Web actions, tasks, rewards & HF / public & Real web agents & Coverage \\
API-Bank~\cite{apibank}, ToolBench~\cite{toolbench}, tau-bench~\cite{taubench} & API calls, outcomes & HF / JSONL & Real API agents & Coverage \\
SWE-agent~\cite{sweagent} & Issue trajectories & HF viewer & Real coding agent & Coverage \\
AndroidCtrl~\cite{androidcontrol}, GUI-Odyssey~\cite{guiodyssey}, ScaleCUA~\cite{scalecua} & Mobile/GUI actions & Public/HF & Real mobile agents & Coverage \\
\midrule
AgentRewardBench~\cite{agentrewardbench} & Success, side-effect, looping & HF annotations & Real BrowserGym agents & RQ2 tasks \\
SATraj-OS~\cite{safactory} & Safety, reward, attack type & HF config & Real desktop agents & RQ2 task \\
OSWorld-Human~\cite{osworldhuman} & Human grouped-action traces & GitHub JSON & Real human OS use & RQ2 task \\
AgentNet~\cite{agentnet} & Step correctness, redundancy & HF JSONL & Real desktop agents & RQ2 tasks \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table*}

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ1: What Does Semantic Profiling Reveal?}
% RQ1：语义分析揭示了什么？

The strongest argument against semantic profiling is that traditional tools ``can already see the same information.''
% 反对语义分析的最强论点是传统工具"已经能看到相同信息"。
RQ1 tests this claim by measuring how much system-effect weight is attributed to the wrong task category when semantic labels are absent.
% RQ1 通过测量在缺少语义标签时有多少系统副作用权重被归因到错误的任务类别来检验此声称。
We progressively add label axes and measure the fraction of weight in buckets that mix observations from multiple task categories.
% 我们逐步添加标签轴，测量混合了多个任务类别观测的桶中的权重比例。

\begin{table}[t]
\centering\small
\caption{Semantic-axis ablation on 183{,}714 system observations
from 325 real sessions. All rows preserve the same total weight.}
\label{tab:mixing}
\begin{tabular}{lrrr}
\toprule
Projection & Unique stacks & Mixed wt.\% & Residual\% \\
\midrule
No semantic labels & 11{,}967 & 90.4 & 44.7 \\
Session label only & 15{,}027 & 84.4 & 33.4 \\
Prompt label only & 24{,}703 & 36.7 & 7.5 \\
Session + prompt & 26{,}829 & 0.0 & 0.0 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

Table~\ref{tab:mixing} shows the result on 325 real Codex/Claude sessions.
% Table~\ref{tab:mixing} 展示了 325 个真实 Codex/Claude 会话上的结果。
Without semantic labels, 90.4\% of system-effect weight falls into mixed buckets.
% 没有语义标签时，90.4\% 的系统副作用权重落入混合桶。
A flat \texttt{cargo~test} counter shows 2{,}903 executions but cannot distinguish whether they came from \texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{refactor}, or \texttt{test} prompts.
% 扁平的 \texttt{cargo test} 计数器显示 2,903 次执行，但无法区分它们来自 \texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}、\texttt{refactor} 还是 \texttt{test} 提示词。
Adding only the prompt label reduces mixed weight to 36.7\% and residual to 7.5\%.
% 仅添加提示词标签就将混合权重降至 36.7\%，残余降至 7.5\%。
The session label alone barely helps (84.4\%), because sessions typically contain multiple intent phases.
% 仅会话标签几乎没有帮助（84.4\%），因为会话通常包含多个意图阶段。

A label-permutation test (1{,}000 shuffles, $p = 0.001$) confirms the separation is not random.
% 标签置换测试（1,000 次洗牌，$p = 0.001$）确认分离不是随机的。
Label quality is validated in RQ3.
% 标签质量在 RQ3 中验证。

RQ1 also tests whether query-time stack selection (R2) adds value beyond flat label grouping.
% RQ1 还测试查询时栈选择（R2）是否在扁平标签分组之外增加价值。
The same two-abstraction model covers all 15 public trace families (Table~\ref{tab:datasets}) without type-specific objects, validating R1.
% 同一双抽象模型覆盖了所有 15 个公开 trace 家族（Table~\ref{tab:datasets}），无需特定类型对象，验证了 R1。
On the four oracle-rich families, the same 13{,}265 operations fold from 9~dataset stacks to 57~phase stacks, 226~semantic stacks, 455~action stacks, or 3{,}757~fixed-session stacks by changing only the stack fields.
% 在四个 oracle 丰富的家族上，同样的 13,265 个 operation 仅通过改变栈字段即可从 9 个数据集栈折叠为 57 个阶段栈、226 个语义栈、455 个操作栈或 3,757 个固定会话栈。
A flat GROUP BY on a single label cannot produce these views because different stack depths answer different questions (task-level budget vs.\ action-level duplication vs.\ session-level drilldown), and the profiler produces all of them from the same operations.
% 单标签的扁平 GROUP BY 无法产生这些视图，因为不同栈深度回答不同问题（任务级预算 vs. 操作级重复 vs. 会话级下钻），而分析器从同一组 operation 生成所有这些视图。

The multi-view design is further validated by metric divergence.
% 多视图设计通过指标差异进一步验证。
The \texttt{time} and \texttt{tokens} views of the same sessions share only 7/10 top prompt categories (Spearman $\rho = 0.623$).
% 同一会话的 \texttt{time} 和 \texttt{tokens} 视图仅共享 7/10 的顶级提示词类别（Spearman $\rho = 0.623$）。
\texttt{network}-tagged prompts rank 8th by time (I/O wait) but 93rd by tokens.
% \texttt{network} 标记的提示词按时间排第 8（I/O 等待）但按 token 排第 93。

When no field chain is provided, the automatic stack-induction mode (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) produces useful groups without domain knowledge.
% 当不提供字段链时，自动栈诱导模式（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）无需领域知识即可产生有用的分组。
On the same six hidden-label tasks used in RQ2, induced stacks produce a median of 12 groups (versus 285 for fixed-session drilldown and 1 for flat summaries), with 4/6 tasks generating variable-depth stacks.
% 在 RQ2 使用的同样六个隐藏标签任务上，诱导栈产生中位 12 个分组（固定会话下钻 285 个，扁平摘要 1 个），4/6 任务生成可变深度栈。
The induced stacks achieve lower AP than hand-configured stacks (median 0.276 vs 0.312) because they use only visible fields, but they reduce inspection work to a median of 65.3\% versus flat summaries without requiring any user configuration.
% 诱导栈的 AP 低于手动配置栈（中位 0.276 vs 0.312），因为它们仅使用可见字段，但将检查工作量降至扁平摘要的 65.3\%，无需任何用户配置。

Figure~\ref{fig:rq1-separation} visualizes the ablation.
% Figure~\ref{fig:rq1-separation} 可视化了消融实验。
Figures~\ref{fig:flamegraph} and~\ref{fig:flamegraph-files} show the resulting flame graphs for the \texttt{tokens} and \texttt{files} views respectively, showing that changing only the stack fields and weight function produces different aggregates from the same operations.
% Figures~\ref{fig:flamegraph} 和~\ref{fig:flamegraph-files} 分别展示了 \texttt{tokens} 和 \texttt{files} 视图的火焰图，表明仅改变栈字段和权重函数即可从同一组 operation 产生不同聚合。

\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/fig-rq1-separation.pdf}
\caption{RQ1: Semantic-axis ablation on 183{,}714 system observations.
Adding prompt labels reduces mixed weight from 90.4\% to 36.7\%.
Session labels alone barely help (84.4\%).}
\Description{Stacked bar chart showing mixed vs separated weight
under four projection choices.}
\label{fig:rq1-separation}
\end{figure}

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-tokens.png}
\caption{Flame graph of the \texttt{tokens} view across 325 real
sessions. Width represents token count. The bottom frames show project
and agent; middle frames show sessions and prompt labels
(\texttt{continue}, \texttt{query}, \texttt{review}, \texttt{design});
top frames show individual LLM calls and models. The same data produces
different views by changing the stack fields
(Table~\ref{tab:views}).}
\Description{Wide flame graph showing token budget distribution across
sessions, prompt categories, and LLM models.}
\label{fig:flamegraph}
\end{figure*}

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-files.png}
\caption{Flame graph of the \texttt{files} view across the same
sessions. Width represents file-operation count.
\texttt{prompt:review} and \texttt{prompt:continue} dominate file
activity. Changing only the stack fields and weight function produces
a different aggregate without re-parsing.}
\Description{Wide flame graph showing file-access distribution across
sessions and prompt categories.}
\label{fig:flamegraph-files}
\end{figure*}

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ2: Does Profiler Output Correspond to Real Problems?}
% RQ2：分析器输出是否对应真实问题？

RQ2 tests whether the profiler's top-ranked groups actually contain real failures, safety violations, or wasted effort.
% RQ2 测试分析器排名靠前的分组是否确实包含真实的故障、安全违规或浪费的算力。
We use public benchmark datasets that provide ground-truth quality labels, hide these labels from the profiler, and check whether the top groups recover them.
% 我们使用提供真实质量标签的公开基准数据集，对分析器隐藏这些标签，然后检查排名靠前的分组是否恢复了它们。
The methodology is analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in a CPU profiler evaluation.
% 该方法类似于在 CPU 分析器评估中注入已知瓶颈。
Public benchmark datasets provide ground-truth labels (failure, safety violation, redundant step, human-task boundary).
% 公开基准数据集提供真实标签（故障、安全违规、冗余步骤、人工任务边界）。
We hide these labels, run the profiler, rank the resulting groups, and check whether the top groups contain the hidden positives.
% 我们隐藏这些标签，运行分析器，排序结果分组，检查顶级分组是否包含隐藏的正例。

The benchmark uses six tasks across four datasets (AgentRewardBench looping and side-effect, SATraj-OS unsafe operation, AgentNet incorrect and redundant step, and OSWorld-Human group start), totaling 34{,}539 operations and 3{,}699 positives.
% 基准使用四个数据集的六个任务（AgentRewardBench 循环和副作用、SATraj-OS 不安全操作、AgentNet 不正确和冗余步骤、OSWorld-Human 组起始），共计 34,539 个 operation 和 3,699 个正例。
We compare six grouping strategies (flat summary, fixed-session drilldown, dataset-native hierarchy, raw-action grouping, operation-stack profiling, and an oracle that uses the hidden labels) and rank groups by the fraction of hidden positives they contain.
% 我们比较六种分组策略（扁平摘要、固定会话下钻、数据集原生层次、原始操作分组、operation stack 分析，以及使用隐藏标签的 oracle），按组包含的隐藏正例比例对组排序。

\begin{table*}[t]
\centering\small
\caption{RQ2 hidden-label localization (medians across six tasks).
AP = average precision. R@5 = recall in top 5 groups. Work@5 = fraction
of total work in top 5 groups. R@30\% = recall at 30\% inspection budget.
WTFP = work-to-first-positive (fraction inspected before finding one positive).
Hidden = 1 means the policy uses hidden labels (oracle upper bound).
``---'' = group count varies by task.}
\label{tab:localization}
\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrrrr}
\toprule
Policy & Hidden & AP & R@5 & F1@5 & Work@5 & R@30\% & WTFP & Groups \\
\midrule
flat:width & 0 & 0.168 & 1.000 & 0.287 & 1.000 & 0.000 & 1.000 & 1.0 \\
fixed-session:query-aware & 0 & 0.348 & 0.023 & 0.043 & 0.016 & 0.356 & 0.004 & 285.0 \\
dataset-native:query-aware & 0 & 0.357 & 0.867 & 0.282 & 0.854 & 0.338 & 0.058 & --- \\
raw-action:query-aware & 0 & 0.274 & 0.244 & 0.220 & 0.151 & 0.333 & 0.037 & --- \\
op-stack:query-aware & 0 & 0.312 & 0.188 & 0.198 & 0.094 & 0.390 & 0.038 & 157.5 \\
op-stack:oracle-upper & 1 & 0.599 & 0.300 & 0.403 & 0.044 & 0.564 & 0.012 & --- \\
label-drilldown:oracle & 1 & 1.000 & 0.670 & 0.797 & 0.115 & 1.000 & 0.038 & --- \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table*}

Table~\ref{tab:localization} summarizes the results.
% Table~\ref{tab:localization} 总结了结果。
Flat summaries recover all positives but require inspecting everything (Work@5\,=\,1.0).
% 扁平摘要恢复所有正例但需要检查全部内容（Work@5 = 1.0）。
Fixed-session drilldown finds a first positive quickly (WTFP\,=\,0.004) but fragments the workload into 285 groups with only 2.3\% top-five recall.
% 固定会话下钻快速找到首个正例（WTFP = 0.004），但将工作量碎片化为 285 个组，前五召回率仅 2.3\%。
Operation-stack profiling inspects 9.4\% of the work in the top five groups, recovers 39.0\% of positives within 30\% of the inspection budget, and reduces groups to 157.5.
% Operation stack 分析在前五组中检查 9.4\% 的工作量，在 30\% 检查预算内恢复 39.0\% 的正例，并将组数减少到 157.5。

Figure~\ref{fig:rq2-tradeoff} visualizes this tradeoff: operation-stack profiling sits in the low-work, moderate-recall region.
% Figure~\ref{fig:rq2-tradeoff} 可视化了这一权衡：operation stack 分析位于低工作量、中等召回率区域。
The comparison also serves as evidence for the two-abstraction model (\S\ref{sec:design}).
% 该比较也作为双抽象模型（\S\ref{sec:design}）的证据。
Fixed-session drilldown and dataset-native hierarchy are alternative abstractions that fix the hierarchy at session or dataset boundaries.
% 固定会话下钻和数据集原生层次是在会话或数据集边界固定层次的替代抽象。
Operation stacks subsume both as special cases (include \texttt{session} in the stack to recover fixed-session; include \texttt{dataset} to recover dataset-native).
% Operation stack 将两者作为特例包含（栈中包含 \texttt{session} 恢复固定会话；包含 \texttt{dataset} 恢复数据集原生）。
On localization, operation stacks improve top-five recall over fixed-session on 5/6 tasks, reduce median group count by 45\%, and save 90\% of inspection work versus flat summaries.
% 在定位方面，operation stack 在 5/6 任务上改进了相对固定会话的前五召回率，中位组数减少 45\%，比扁平摘要节省 90\% 的检查工作量。
Fixed-session drilldown retains lower work-to-first-positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary.
% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上保持更低的首个正例工作量，确认分析器和调试器是互补的。

\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/baseline-tradeoff.png}
\caption{RQ2: Inspection work vs.\ recall at 30\% inspection budget.
Operation-stack profiling (labeled) achieves low work (0.094) with moderate
recall (0.39), while flat requires full inspection and fixed-session
fragments into 285 groups. Oracle policies (large dots) are upper bounds.}
\Description{Scatter plot showing inspection work versus budget recall
for eight profiling policies.}
\label{fig:rq2-tradeoff}
\end{figure}

Statistical validation supports these comparisons.
% 统计验证支持这些比较。
Bootstrap (10{,}000 resamples) and label-permutation (2{,}000 trials) confirm that the AP differences are stable and exceed the 95\% confidence threshold on all six tasks.
% Bootstrap（10,000 次重采样）和标签置换（2,000 次试验）确认 AP 差异在所有六个任务上是稳定的，且超过 95\% 置信阈值。

Stack depth is an actionable configuration parameter, not a fixed choice.
% 栈深度是一个可操作的配置参数，而非固定选择。
Sweeping the induced-stack depth cap from 1 to 5 on the same six tasks, AP peaks at depth 3 (median 0.287) while inspection work is lowest at depth 5 (median 0.473).
% 在同样六个任务上将诱导栈深度上限从 1 扫到 5，AP 在深度 3 时达到峰值（中位 0.287），而检查工作量在深度 5 时最低（中位 0.473）。
Different tasks achieve their best AP at different depths (2, 3, 4, and 5), confirming that depth should be tuned per objective rather than fixed globally.
% 不同任务在不同深度（2、3、4 和 5）达到最佳 AP，确认深度应按目标调整而非全局固定。

Beyond localization, we test whether profiler output suggests concrete configuration improvements.
% 除定位外，我们还测试分析器输出是否建议具体的配置改进。
We modify stack fields, mapping rules, or rankers in the profile spec and re-run on the same operations.
% 我们在 profile spec 中修改栈字段、映射规则或排序器，然后在相同 operation 上重新运行。
Five of six changes improve AP, top-five recall, and work-to-first-positive (median AP improvement 0.038).
% 六个变更中有五个改进了 AP、前五召回率和首个正例工作量（中位 AP 改进 0.038）。
Three reusable patterns emerge: (1)~safety/side-effect tasks benefit from field and ranker changes; (2)~step-quality tasks benefit from stack-based localization followed by fixed-session drilldown for examples; (3)~human-boundary tasks require boundary-derived fields.
% 三种可复用模式浮现：(1) 安全/副作用任务受益于字段和排序器变更；(2) 步骤质量任务受益于基于栈的定位后跟固定会话下钻获取示例；(3) 人工边界任务需要边界衍生字段。
The OSWorld-Human task shows that features visible without the hidden labels are insufficient for detecting task boundaries.
% OSWorld-Human 任务表明不使用隐藏标签时可见的特征不足以检测任务边界。
Adding fields derived from the hidden boundary annotations improves AP from 0.240 to 0.258 and reduces groups from 108 to 74, confirming that boundary detection requires oracle information.
% 添加从隐藏边界标注衍生的字段将 AP 从 0.240 提高到 0.258，组数从 108 减少到 74，确认边界检测需要 oracle 信息。

Ablating rank features reveals that 7 features (including \texttt{repeat\_signal} and write-action) drive localization, while 3 mislead the ranker.
% 排名特征消融显示 7 个特征（包括 \texttt{repeat\_signal} 和 write-action）驱动定位，而 3 个误导排序器。
Manually correcting the misleading features improves AP on 2/3 cases, but the correction requires offline scoring rather than automatic learning.
% 手动修正误导特征在 2/3 案例上改进了 AP，但修正需要离线评分而非自动学习。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ3: How Accurate Are the Labels?}
% RQ3：标签有多准确？

RQ1 and RQ2 assume that semantic labels are useful.
% RQ1 和 RQ2 假设语义标签是有用的。
RQ3 tests whether the labels themselves are accurate.
% RQ3 测试标签本身是否准确。
For structured traces (public datasets), we compare mapping-derived labels against ground-truth annotations.
% 对于结构化 trace（公开数据集），我们将映射衍生标签与真实标注进行比较。
For free-form traces (real sessions), we measure the operational reliability and syntax validity of the intent-attribution backends.
% 对于自由形式 trace（真实会话），我们测量意图归因后端的运行可靠性和语法有效性。
Semantic accuracy of the LLM/regex tagger on free-form prompts remains future work because none of the available datasets (67{,}304 rows across 6 sources) simultaneously expose free-form text and ground-truth semantic labels, making same-input accuracy evaluation infeasible with current data.
% LLM/正则标注器在自由形式提示词上的语义精度仍是未来工作，因为现有数据集（6 个来源共 67,304 行）没有同时暴露自由形式文本和真实语义标签，使得同输入精度评估在当前数据下不可行。

On 325 real sessions, the LLM tagger processes 118{,}021 tag requests with zero failures, 100\% syntax validity, and 70\% cache hit rate (operational details in RQ4).
% 在 325 个真实会话上，LLM 标注器处理了 118,021 个标注请求，零失败，100\% 语法有效性，70\% 缓存命中率（运行细节见 RQ4）。

Public benchmark datasets provide native action labels that serve as ground truth for mapping quality.
% 公开基准数据集提供原生操作标签作为映射质量的真实标准。
We run a leave-dataset-out evaluation.
% 我们运行留一数据集评估。
For each of 9 datasets, we train mapping rules on the other 8 and measure V-measure between the mapping-derived \texttt{phase} field and the dataset's native \texttt{action} labels, plus boundary F1 between mapped phase boundaries and native action boundaries.
% 对于 9 个数据集中的每一个，我们在其余 8 个上训练映射规则，测量映射衍生的 \texttt{phase} 字段与数据集原生 \texttt{action} 标签之间的 V-measure，以及映射阶段边界与原生操作边界之间的边界 F1。

\begin{table}[t]
\centering\small
\caption{Leave-dataset-out mapping quality. V-measure between
mapping-derived \texttt{phase} and native \texttt{action} labels.
13{,}265 operations from the four oracle-rich families
across 9 held-out evaluations.}
\label{tab:vmeasure}
\begin{tabular}{lrrr}
\toprule
Held-out dataset & Ops & V-measure & Boundary F1 \\
\midrule
mind2web & 774 & 1.000 & 1.000 \\
webshop-expert & 2{,}504 & 1.000 & 1.000 \\
swe-agent & 496 & 0.926 & 0.962 \\
weblinx-chat & 500 & 0.872 & 0.860 \\
agenttrek & 200 & 0.862 & --- \\
gui-odyssey & 7{,}868 & 0.811 & 0.842 \\
android-control & 9 & 0.716 & 0.727 \\
toolbench & 866 & 0.134 & 0.353 \\
api-bank & 48 & 0.000 & --- \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/fig-rq3-vmeasure.pdf}
\caption{RQ3: Leave-dataset-out V-measure between mapping-derived
\texttt{phase} and native \texttt{action} labels. The dashed line
marks 0.7. Seven of nine datasets exceed this threshold.}
\Description{Bar chart showing V-measure for nine held-out datasets,
with a dashed line at 0.7.}
\label{fig:rq3-vmeasure}
\end{figure}

Table~\ref{tab:vmeasure} and Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} show the results.
% Table~\ref{tab:vmeasure} 和 Figure~\ref{fig:rq3-vmeasure} 展示了结果。
On 7/9 datasets, V-measure exceeds 0.7, indicating strong agreement between mapping-derived and native labels.
% 在 7/9 数据集上，V-measure 超过 0.7，表明映射衍生标签与原生标签之间有很强的一致性。
The two low-scoring datasets (toolbench, api-bank) have atypical action vocabularies that the held-out mapping rules do not cover.
% 两个低分数据集（toolbench、api-bank）具有保留映射规则未覆盖的非典型操作词汇。

A supervised boundary predictor further validates the mapping approach.
% 有监督的边界预测器进一步验证了映射方法。
On OSWorld-Human held-out adjacent pairs, a learned boundary predictor achieves F1~0.77, beating the best simple baseline (\texttt{always\_boundary}, F1~0.71).
% 在 OSWorld-Human 保留相邻对上，学习的边界预测器达到 F1 约 0.77，超过最佳简单基线（\texttt{always\_boundary}，F1 约 0.71）。
Learned predictors beat simple baselines on 4/5 tested datasets, while AgentRewardBench looping is fully explained by a single repeat-signal feature (baseline F1~1.0).
% 学习预测器在 4/5 测试的数据集上超过简单基线，而 AgentRewardBench 循环完全由单个重复信号特征解释（基线 F1 约 1.0）。
These comparisons confirm that mapping rules produce useful labels but are not automatic intent discovery.
% 这些比较确认映射规则产生有用的标签，但不是自动意图发现。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ4: What Is the Profiling Cost?}
% RQ4：分析开销是多少？

\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler, so it adds zero overhead to the agent's runtime.
% \sys 是离线事后分析器，对智能体运行时不增加任何开销。
The profiling cost is the time and resources spent after the session ends.
% 分析开销是会话结束后花费的时间和资源。

We re-execute 76 tracked profile specs twice (152 invocations) to measure cost and verify determinism.
% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 profile spec 两次（152 次调用）来测量开销并验证确定性。
All 76 specs produce byte-identical output across both runs.
% 全部 76 个 spec 在两次运行中产生字节相同的输出。
Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per spec (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
% 中位分析时间为每 spec 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
The slowest specs process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness-check specs all complete within 1.6\,s.
% 最慢的 spec 处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性检查 spec 全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
The full profile-spec composition path (operation files, query predicates, rank rules, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested configuration variants.
% 完整的 profile spec 组合路径（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名规则和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试的配置变体中保持确定性。

Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real sessions, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per label using a local 3B-parameter model.
% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test labels).
% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
Because labels are cached, re-profiling the same sessions with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Related Work}
% 相关工作

Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} establish the folded-stack lineage.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 建立了折叠栈的谱系。
Profiles are weighted samples with location hierarchies.
% 概要是带有位置层次的加权样本。
Pprof supports sample labels and can visualize them as pseudo stack frames through tag-root/tag-leaf options.
% Pprof 支持样本标签，并可通过 tag-root/tag-leaf 选项将其可视化为伪栈帧。
Perfetto generalizes trace ingestion with SQL-based analysis and derived events~\cite{perfetto}.
% Perfetto 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件~\cite{perfetto}泛化了 trace 摄取。
These systems support query-time aggregation, so \sys does not claim novelty for flexible aggregation alone.
% 这些系统支持查询时聚合，因此 \sys 不单独声称灵活聚合的新颖性。
The difference is structural.
% 差异是结构性的。
Pprof's tagroot adds label-derived frames to an existing execution call stack.
% Pprof 的 tagroot 在已有执行调用栈上添加标签衍生帧。
Agent traces have no execution stack, so the entire profiling structure must be constructed from semantic fields.
% 智能体 trace 没有执行栈，因此整个分析结构必须从语义字段构建。
The evaluation also differs: \sys scores profiler output against hidden agent-trajectory labels, a methodology with no analogue in CPU profiling.
% 评估也不同：\sys 将分析器输出与隐藏的智能体轨迹标签进行评分，这一方法在 CPU 分析中没有对应物。

OpenTelemetry GenAI and OpenInference standardize GenAI spans~\cite{otel, openinference}.
% OpenTelemetry GenAI 和 OpenInference 标准化了 GenAI span~\cite{otel, openinference}。
LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}, and Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} provide trace visualization, session management, evaluations, and dashboards.
% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse} 和 Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 提供 trace 可视化、会话管理、评估和仪表盘。
AgentOps~\cite{agentops} argues for structured agent observability covering goals, plans, tools, and artifacts.
% AgentOps~\cite{agentops} 主张涵盖目标、计划、工具和制品的结构化智能体可观测性。
AgentTelemetry~\cite{agenttelemetry} defines 14 fault types over 9 agent-specific span kinds that extend OpenTelemetry for agent orchestration phases.
% AgentTelemetry~\cite{agenttelemetry} 定义了 9 种智能体特定 span 类型上的 14 种故障类型，扩展了 OpenTelemetry 以覆盖智能体编排阶段。
Wang et al.~\cite{agenttraces-trust} survey evidence tracing and execution provenance as foundations for agent accountability.
% Wang et al.~\cite{agenttraces-trust} 综述了证据追踪和执行溯源作为智能体问责的基础。
These systems excel at single-execution debugging or fault detection.
% 这些系统擅长单次执行调试或故障检测。
\sys complements them with cross-session aggregate profiling.
% \sys 以跨会话聚合分析作为补充。

content.text:
你说得对，"What Does Semantic Profiling Reveal?" 太模糊了——任何实验都可以"reveal"什么东西。好的 RQ 应该能用具体数据回答 yes/no 或给出 measurement。

**RQ1 实际在测的是：** 加了语义标签后，有多少原本被混在一起的系统副作用可以被正确归因？

更好的标题：

| 候选 | 优缺点 |
|------|--------|
| "Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?" | ✅ 直接问 attribution 改善了没有，可以用 90.4%→36.7% 回答 |
| "How Much Attribution Do Flat Views Lose?" | ✅ 从反面问，数字直接回答 |
| "Does Adding Semantic Labels Separate Mixed System Effects?" | 比原来好但 "mixed system effects" 还是略内部 |

我建议 **"Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?"** ——和 intro 里 "resource attribution" vs "input distribution" 的对比呼应。

---

关于需不需要新增 RQ——看当前 4 个覆盖了什么：

| RQ | 问的是 | Claim 覆盖 |
|----|--------|-----------|
| RQ1 | 语义分析是不是比 flat/session 视图多看到东西？ | 模型有效性 |
| RQ2 | profiler 输出是不是真问题？ | 实际有用性 |
| RQ3 | 标签准不准？ | 标签质量 |
| RQ4 | 开销能不能接受？ | 实用性 |

**对 workshop paper 来说 4 个 RQ 已经完整**——覆盖了"有没有用(RQ1+RQ2)"、"可不可信(RQ3)"、"能不能用(RQ4)"三个维度。

唯一可能缺的是 **"通用性"**（不同类型 agent 上能不能用），但这已经在 RQ1 里通过 15 个 trace families 覆盖了，不需要单独一个 RQ。

你觉得 RQ1 标题改成 "Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?" 可以吗？

\subsection{RQ2: Does Profiler Output Correspond to Real Problems?}
% RQ2：分析器输出是否对应真实问题？

RQ2 tests whether the profiler's top-ranked groups actually contain real failures, safety violations, or wasted effort.
% RQ2 测试分析器排名靠前的分组是否确实包含真实的故障、安全违规或浪费的算力。
We use public benchmark datasets that provide ground-truth quality labels, hide these labels from the profiler, and check whether the top groups recover them.
% 我们使用提供真实质量标签的公开基准数据集，对分析器隐藏这些标签，然后检查排名靠前的分组是否恢复了它们。
The methodology is analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in a CPU profiler evaluation.
% 该方法类似于在 CPU 分析器评估中注入已知瓶颈。
Public benchmark datasets provide ground-truth labels (failure, safety violation, redundant step, human-task boundary).
% 公开基准数据集提供真实标签（故障、安全违规、冗余步骤、人工任务边界）。
We hide these labels, run the profiler, rank the resulting groups, and check whether the top groups contain the hidden positives.
% 我们隐藏这些标签，运行分析器，排序结果分组，检查顶级分组是否包含隐藏的正例。

The benchmark uses six tasks across four datasets (AgentRewardBench looping and side-effect, SATraj-OS unsafe operation, AgentNet incorrect and redundant step, and OSWorld-Human group start), totaling 34{,}539 operations and 3{,}699 positives.
% 基准使用四个数据集的六个任务（AgentRewardBench 循环和副作用、SATraj-OS 不安全操作、AgentNet 不正确和冗余步骤、OSWorld-Human 组起始），共计 34,539 个 operation 和 3,699 个正例。
We compare six grouping strategies (flat summary, fixed-session drilldown, dataset-native hierarchy, raw-action grouping, operation-stack profiling, and an oracle that uses the hidden labels) and rank groups by the fraction of hidden positives they contain.
% 我们比较六种分组策略（扁平摘要、固定会话下钻、数据集原生层次、原始操作分组、operation stack 分析，以及使用隐藏标签的 oracle），按组包含的隐藏正例比例对组排序。

% 不同任务在不同深度（2、3、4 和 5）达到最佳 AP，确认深度应按目标调整而非全局固定。

Beyond localization, we test whether profiler output suggests concrete configuration improvements.
% 除定位外，我们还测试分析器输出是否建议具体的配置改进。

% 我们在 profile spec 中修改栈字段、映射规则或排序器，然后在相同 operation 上重新运行。
Five of six changes improve AP, top-five recall, and work-to-first-positive (median AP improvement 0.038).
% 六个变更中有五个改进了 AP、前五召回率和首个正例工作量（中位 AP 改进 0.038）。
Three reusable patterns emerge: (1)~safety/side-effect tasks benefit from field and ranker changes; (2)~step-quality tasks benefit from stack-based localization followed by fixed-session drilldown for examples; (3)~human-boundary tasks require boundary-derived fields.
% 三种可复用模式浮现：(1) 安全/副作用任务受益于字段和排序器变更；(2) 步骤质量任务受益于基于栈的定位后跟固定会话下钻获取示例；(3) 人工边界任务需要边界衍生字段。

\section{Evaluation}
% 评估
\label{sec:eval}

We use two classes of data.
% 我们使用两类数据。
\emph{Real agent sessions}: 325 readable local sessions (198~Codex, 50~Claude, 77~Claude subagent) from a multi-month development project, containing 183{,}714 system observations.
% 真实智能体会话：来自一个多月开发项目的 325 个可读本地会话（198 个 Codex、50 个 Claude、77 个 Claude 子智能体），包含 183,714 个系统观测。
\emph{Public labeled traces}: 15 families covering web, mobile, desktop, software, API, and dialogue agents (Table~\ref{tab:datasets}), totaling 47{,}590 operations through mapping rules.
% 公开标注 trace：15 个家族，涵盖 web、移动、桌面、软件、API 和对话智能体（Table~\ref{tab:datasets}），通过映射规则共计 47,590 个 operation。
All public traces are real agent or human executions collected and labeled by their respective benchmark projects.
% 所有公开 trace 都是由各自基准项目收集和标注的真实智能体或人类执行。
Four oracle-rich families (AgentRewardBench, SATraj-OS, AgentNet, OSWorld-Human) provide hidden ground-truth labels for RQ2.
% 四个 oracle 丰富的家族（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet、OSWorld-Human）为 RQ2 提供隐藏的真实标签。
We measure semantic separation (mixed-weight percentage), localization quality (AP, recall, work-to-first-positive), and label agreement (V-measure, boundary F1).
% 我们测量语义分离度（混合权重百分比）、定位质量（AP、召回率、首个正例工作量）和标签一致性（V-measure、边界 F1）。

\centering\small
\caption{Public labeled trace families. All traces are real agent or
human executions. The bottom four rows provide oracle labels for RQ2.}
\label{tab:datasets}
\begin{tabular}{p{0.17\linewidth}p{0.22\linewidth}p{0.15\linewidth}p{0.17\linewidth}p{0.17\linewidth}}
\toprule
Family & Native labels & Access & Trace origin & Eval.\ role \\
\midrule
WebLINX~\cite{weblinx}, Mind2Web~\cite{mind2web}, AgentTrek~\cite{agenttrek}, WebShop~\cite{webshop} & Web actions, tasks, rewards & HF / public & Real web agents & Coverage \\
API-Bank~\cite{apibank}, ToolBench~\cite{toolbench}, tau-bench~\cite{taubench} & API calls, outcomes & HF / JSONL & Real API agents & Coverage \\
SWE-agent~\cite{sweagent} & Issue trajectories & HF viewer & Real coding agent & Coverage \\
AndroidCtrl~\cite{androidcontrol}, GUI-Odyssey~\cite{guiodyssey}, ScaleCUA~\cite{scalecua} & Mobile/GUI actions & Public/HF & Real mobile agents & Coverage \\
\midrule
AgentRewardBench~\cite{agentrewardbench} & Success, side-effect, looping & HF annotations & Real BrowserGym agents & RQ2 tasks \\
SATraj-OS~\cite{safactory} & Safety, reward, attack type & HF config & Real desktop agents & RQ2 task \\
OSWorld-Human~\cite{osworldhuman} & Human grouped-action traces & GitHub JSON & Real human OS use & RQ2 task \\
AgentNet~\cite{agentnet} & Step correctness, redundancy & HF JSONL & Real desktop agents & RQ2 tasks \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table*}

\subsection{RQ1: Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?}
% RQ1：语义分析能否改善资源归因？

The strongest argument against semantic profiling is that traditional tools ``can already see the same information.''
% 反对语义分析的最强论点是传统工具"已经能看到相同信息"。
RQ1 tests this claim by measuring how much system-effect weight is attributed to the wrong task category when semantic labels are absent.

% 没有语义标签时，90.4\% 的系统副作用权重落入混合桶。

Adding only the prompt label reduces mixed weight to 36.7\% and residual to 7.5\%.
% 仅添加提示词标签就将混合权重降至 36.7\%，残余降至 7.5\%。
The session label alone barely helps (84.4\%), because sessions typically contain multiple intent phases.
% 仅会话标签几乎没有帮助（84.4\%），因为会话通常包含多个意图阶段。

A flat GROUP BY on a single label cannot produce these views because different stack depths answer different questions (task-level budget vs.\ action-level duplication vs.\ session-level drilldown), and the profiler produces all of them from the same operations.
% 单标签的扁平 GROUP BY 无法产生这些视图，因为不同栈深度回答不同问题（任务级预算 vs. 操作级重复 vs. 会话级下钻），而分析器从同一组 operation 生成所有这些视图。

The multi-view design is further validated by metric divergence.
% 多视图设计通过指标差异进一步验证。
The \texttt{time} and \texttt{tokens} views of the same sessions share only 7/10 top prompt categories (Spearman $\rho = 0.623$).
% 同一会话的 \texttt{time} 和 \texttt{tokens} 视图仅共享 7/10 的顶级提示词类别（Spearman $\rho = 0.623$）。
\texttt{network}-tagged prompts rank 8th by time (I/O wait) but 93rd by tokens.
% \texttt{network} 标记的提示词按时间排第 8（I/O 等待）但按 token 排第 93。

When no field chain is provided, the automatic stack-induction mode (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) produces useful groups without domain knowledge.
% 当不提供字段链时，自动栈诱导模式（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）无需领域知识即可产生有用的分组。
On the same six hidden-label tasks used in RQ2, induced stacks produce a median of 12 groups (versus 285 for fixed-session drilldown and 1 for flat summaries), with 4/6 tasks generating variable-depth stacks.

% 诱导栈的 AP 低于手动配置栈（中位 0.276 vs 0.312），因为它们仅使用可见字段，但将检查工作量降至扁平摘要的 65.3\%，无需任何用户配置。

你说得对。我用读者视角重新审视，问题很明显：

## 每个 RQ 缺什么

**RQ1（L538-607）：** 读者到 L541 时知道"测的是语义标签有没有用"，但到了 L582 突然跳到"query-time stack selection (R2)"，没有过渡——读者不知道为什么 RQ1 要测两件事。自动栈诱导（L598-602）更突兀——它突然出现，没说为什么在 RQ1 里测这个。

**核心问题：** RQ1 塞了三个子实验（消融、多视图、自动栈）但没有 upfront 告诉读者"RQ1 测三件事"。

**RQ2（L649-735）：** 开头还行（L652-656 说了测什么、怎么测），但 L725-735 的深度 sweep 突然出现——读者不知道这和"profiler 输出对不对"有什么关系。

**RQ3（L751-811）：** 开头最好——L760-762 清楚说了结构化 trace 测映射、自由形式 trace 测可靠性。但 "operational reliability and syntax validity"（L766）是内部术语。

**RQ4（L813-858）：** 最清楚，没问题。

## 修法

每个 RQ 的开头需要一个 **"这个 RQ 测什么，怎么测，测几件事"的 1-2 句 roadmap**。让我逐个修。

**RQ1：** 加一句 roadmap 说清楚测三件事。

27	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities across hundreds of

38	traditional software does not directly apply because agent traces lack
39	deterministic identifiers and runtime call-stack hierarchies.

41	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model}: uniform
42	\emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
43	\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
44	query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
45	% 我们提出语义 operation stack 模型：统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。
46	\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
47	for \emph{intent attribution} (deriving deterministic labels from
48	natural-language fields) and \emph{stack construction} (building
49	aggregation hierarchies from available fields), compiling local agent
50	traces into pprof-compatible profiles.
51	% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔算法的 profiler，包括意图归因（从自然语言字段派生确定性标签）和栈构造（从可用字段构建聚合层次），将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
52	On 325 real agent sessions, semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
53	system-effect weight that session-level views merge.
54	% 在 325 个真实智能体会话上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
55	On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
56	(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
57	problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
58	fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
59	% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。
60	\end{abstract}

64	%% ===================================================================
65	\section{Introduction}
66	\label{sec:intro}
67	
68	%% ¶1: Background + context
69	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
70	layers: high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
71	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
72	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
73	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
74	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
75	over weeks or months.
76	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
77	
78	%% ¶2: Problem
79	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
80	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions to determine
81	which categories of tasks consume the most token budget, where
82	failures concentrate across workflows, and which behavioral patterns
83	trigger unsafe system side-effects.
84	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
85	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
86	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
87	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
88	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
89	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
90	
91	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
92	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
93	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
94	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
95	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
96	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
97	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
98	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
99	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
100	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
101	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
102	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
103	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
104	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
105	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
106	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
107	
108	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
109	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
110	software.
111	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
112	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
113	single chart where width represents cost.
114	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
115	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
116	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
117	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
118	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
119	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
120	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
121	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
122	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
123	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
124	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
125	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
126	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
127	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
128	function calls produce stack frames.
129	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
130	
131	%% ¶5: Model
132	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
133	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
134	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
135	traces.
136	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
137	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
138	components.
139	% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
140	\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
141	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
142	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
143	objects.
144	% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。
145	\emph{Operation stacks} are ordered lists of fields chosen at query
146	time; each operation is projected to a frame sequence, and operations
147	with identical sequences merge, producing the folded-stack
148	representation that flame graphs visualize.
149	% Operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表；每个 operation 被投影到帧序列，具有相同序列的 operation 合并，产生火焰图可视化的折叠栈表示。
150	Different field selections answer different questions (by task
151	category, by execution phase, by session, or by action type) from
152	the same data.
153	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题（按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话或按操作类型）。
154	
155	%% ¶6: This paper + system + results

# Academic Paper Writing Review & Fix (Sentence-Level)

Review the LaTeX file at `` sentence by sentence for academic writing quality. If no argument is given, ask which section to review.

**Scope:** This skill covers sentence-level prose mechanics (punctuation, structure, word choice, flow patterns). For terminology consistency, invented jargon, cross-section concept coherence, and information flow, use the `check-terminology-infoflow` skill instead.

## Review process

1. Read the entire file (or specified section)
2. For each paragraph, analyze every sentence against the checklist below
3. Report issues grouped by severity: **Must fix** (clarity/logic errors), **Should fix** (antipatterns), **Consider** (style preferences)
4. For each issue, give the line number, quote the problematic text, explain the problem, and suggest a concrete rewrite
5. Apply the fixes directly with the Edit tool — Must fix first, then Should fix, then evaluate each Consider item and apply the ones that improve the text (note rejected ones with a one-line reason). Do not ask the user which fixes to apply, and do not silently discard anything below Must fix. Exception: when invoked read-only as a review subagent (e.g. from iter-refine-writing), report findings only and make no edits — the calling agent applies them.

## Editing discipline

- **Minimal targeted changes only** — never rewrite, restructure, or delete existing content unless explicitly asked.
- **When updating numbers/data, do NOT touch prose wording.**
- **Preserve the user's exact wording and meaning.** Do not soften, strengthen, or "fix grammar" unless asked; flag suggestions instead of applying them.
- **Avoid absolutist words** like "cannot", "impossible", "never" unless structurally true.
- **Deep pass on first attempt** — do thorough review (not just mechanical/surface fixes). Shallow first passes waste user time.
- **Verify before claiming done** — recompile LaTeX, check it builds. Do not claim "fixed" until verified.

## Critical rules (for fixes)

- **System name via `\sys` macro only.** Never hardcode the system name in prose — always use `\sys`. Flag any hardcoded system name as Must-fix.
- **NEVER delete design decisions or technical content.** Compression means better prose, not less information.
- **NEVER change the meaning** of a sentence. If unsure, ask.
- **NEVER remove a scope-bearing hedge** (`suggest ... on the selected subset`, `in our setting`, `up to`): it protects the claim from outrunning its evidence. Only collapse stacked hedges down to one.
- **Always diff-check** after multiple edits to ensure no content was lost.

---

## Punctuation rules

### No em-dashes (`---`)
Never use em-dashes in paper text. Use commas, parentheses, or restructure the sentence. Table cells using `---` for "not applicable" are acceptable.

### No semicolons joining independent clauses
Rewrite as:
- Two sentences (period)
- One sentence with a conjunction (", and", ", but", ", so")
- One sentence with a causal connector ("because", "since", "therefore")

Semicolons ARE acceptable inside parenthetical lists and numbered enumerations.

**Bad:** `The engine propagates labels; rules fire at each event.`
**Good:** `The engine propagates labels, and rules fire at each event.`

### Colons (avoid unless introducing a numbered list)
Only use colons for introducing a **numbered list** with explicit markers like (1), (2), (3).

Never use colons for unlabeled lists, `claim: evidence`, `setup: result`, or `observation: explanation` patterns. Use causal connectors or split into two sentences.

**Bad:** `Optimization spans three layers: source, LLVM, and JIT.` (unlabeled list)
**Good:** `The framework addresses three goals: (1) crash isolation, (2) bounded action spaces, and (3) multi-layer feedback.` (numbered list)

### Parentheticals (avoid unless necessary)
Only use parentheses for: (1) citations/references (Figure 1, Table 2), (2) abbreviations on first use. Never for lists or explanations.

---

## Sentence structure antipatterns

### Weak openings
Avoid starting sentences with "It is", "There is/are", "This is". Use a concrete subject.

**Bad:** `There are three hooks that the engine attaches to.`
**Good:** `The engine attaches to three hooks.`

### Subject-verb separation (Gopen & Swan)
Keep the grammatical subject within 7 words of its verb.

**Bad:** `The protocol, which was developed over three years by a distributed team working across four time zones, handles failover.`
**Good:** `The protocol handles failover. A distributed team developed it over three years across four time zones.`

### Dangling modifiers
The modifier must attach to the grammatical subject.

**Bad:** `Using eBPF, the policy is enforced at the kernel level.`
**Good:** `Using eBPF, the engine enforces the policy at the kernel level.`

### Passive voice (when the agent matters)
Passive is fine for methodology when the actor is obvious ("traces were collected"), but use active voice when the actor matters.

**Bad:** `Labels are propagated by the engine at each system event.`
**Good:** `The engine propagates labels at each system event.`

### Note-like prose (3+ short declaratives in a row)
Academic prose uses causal connectors, subordinate clauses, and flowing sentences. Short declarative sentences strung together read like bullet points.

**Bad:** `Labels propagate at fork. The child inherits the parent mask. Rules check the mask at each event.`
**Good:** `Labels propagate at fork, so the child inherits the parent mask and rules can check it at each event.`

Tie-breaker: targets runs of **three or more** short declaratives. A pair of sentences from splitting an overlong sentence is fine.

### No bullet points or lists in narrative prose
Convert lists to flowing paragraphs with causal connectors.

**Exceptions:** contribution lists, algorithm pseudocode, comparison tables, explicit enumerations referenced later.

### Subject first
Start important sentences with a concrete actor or object. Prefer "The profiler ranks...", "Operation stacks group..." over vague starts like "This shows...", "These checks...".

### Use explicit author subjects when appropriate
For author choices: "We compare...", "We evaluate...", "We find..."
For mechanism behavior: "The profiler ranks...", "The operation stack groups..."

### Vague referents
"This", "it", "they" must have an unambiguous antecedent. If unclear, name the referent explicitly.

**Bad:** `The engine checks labels and fires rules. This improves compliance.`
**Good:** `The engine checks labels and fires rules. This label-checking mechanism improves compliance.`

**Bad:** `We test three configurations. It shows that caching helps.`
**Good:** `We test three configurations. The comparison shows that caching helps.`

### Topic position / stress position (Gopen & Swan)
Put old/known information at the sentence start (backward link). Put the new, emphatic information at the sentence end (stress position).

**Bad:** `A 40\% reduction in latency results from label caching.`
**Good:** `Label caching reduces latency by 40\%.`

"Label caching" is already known from context; "40%" is the new finding that belongs at the stress position.

### Too many small experiments
Evaluation sections should organize around a small number of claim-facing research questions (usually 3-4), not many small script-shaped experiments. If the prose enumerates many tiny checks, consolidate.

**Bad:** `We run R320 for ranking, R325 for depth, R358 for boundaries, R366 for fields, and R400 for suitability.`
**Good:** `The evaluation asks whether operation stacks improve localization and reduce inspection work. It then explains which stack fields drive those gains.`

---

## Word-level antipatterns

| Antipattern | Fix |
|---|---|
| "in order to" | "to" |
| "utilize" / "utilization" | "use" |
| "it is important to note that" | delete or rephrase |
| "it should be noted that" | delete or rephrase |
| "there is/are ... that" | rewrite with real subject |
| "due to the fact that" | "because" |
| "a number of" | "several" or the actual count |
| "in the case of" | "for" or "when" |
| "is able to" | "can" |
| "has the ability to" | "can" |
| "prior to" | "before" |
| "subsequent to" | "after" |
| "with respect to" | "for" or "about" |
| "in terms of" | rephrase directly |
| "the fact that" | delete or use "that" |

### Nominalizations
Use the verb form. "make assumption" → "assume"; "perform analysis" → "analyze"; "is a requirement" → "requires".

### Unnecessary adverbs
Cut "very", "extremely", "basically", "actually", "really", "significantly" unless they carry measurable meaning. Replace vague intensifiers with numbers.

---

## Claim & evidence patterns

### Claim before evidence
State what the numbers mean before giving the numbers. The reader should know why the data matters before seeing the data.

**Bad:** `217 (36%) have one clause. 231 (38%) have two.` (data dump)
**Good:** `Most policies are structurally simple: 74% have at most two clauses.`

### Paper, not project report
Reject prose that reads like a status update, experiment diary, artifact index, or TODO list. A paper section should tell the reader what claim matters and why the evidence supports it.

### Evidence without a subject
Evidence sentences need an actor or object before the measurement.

**Bad:** `The generated table shows that operation stacks reduce inspection work.`
**Good:** `Operation stacks reduce inspection work, as the ranking experiment shows.`

---

## Hedging rules

### Redundant hedging
One hedge per claim is enough. Remove stacked hedges. Do not hedge your own measurements.

**Bad:** `This may potentially suggest that the overhead could possibly be acceptable.`
**Good:** `This suggests the overhead is acceptable.`

**Protected hedges — never remove:** a hedge carrying claim scope (`in our setting`, `on the 12 selected workloads`). Remove the stack, keep one scope-bearing hedge.

### Self-attacking sentences (delete)
Delete sentences that volunteer weaknesses or apologize for choices no reviewer asked about. Move substance to Limitations if needed.

**Test:** does the phrase restrict what the claim covers (hedge — keep), or concede that the work is weak (self-attack — delete)?

---

## Quick self-edit pass (apply to every sentence)

1. Can I delete the first word/phrase without losing meaning?
2. Is a verb hidden inside a noun? Undo the nominalization.
3. Is the subject more than 7 words from its verb?
4. Does the sentence end on the most important new information?
5. Does the sentence start with something the reader already knows?
6. Is an adverb doing the work a number should do?
7. Am I hedging my own result?
8. Does "this/it/that" have a clear antecedent? If not, name the referent.

## Fix priority

1. **Clarity:** dangling modifiers, vague referents, missing motivation
2. **Structure:** semicolons, note-like prose, weak openings, passive voice, nominalizations
3. **Word choice:** verbose phrases from the antipattern table
4. **Punctuation:** colons before non-lists, em-dashes

## Output format

For each issue found:
```
L<line>: "<quoted text>"
  Problem: <what's wrong>
  Fix: "<suggested rewrite>"
```

End with a summary: total issues by severity, and the top 3 most impactful changes.

After all fixes, recompile and verify. Provide:
- Number of sentences changed
- Categories of changes made
- Any sentences flagged but NOT changed (and why)

22	\begin{document}
23	
24	\title{AgentProf: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}
25	
26	\begin{abstract}
27	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities across hundreds of
28	sessions, but existing observability tools provide only per-session
29	debugging views with no cross-session profiling layer.
30	% AI 智能体跨数百个会话编排多步骤活动，但现有可观测性工具仅提供按会话的调试视图，没有跨会话的 profiling 层。
31	To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need
32	aggregate analysis of which task categories consume the most budget,
33	where failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe
34	side-effects, but today the only option is manual inspection of
35	individual sessions.
36	% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要聚合分析哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用，但目前唯一的选择是逐个检查单个会话。
37	The flame-graph profiling methodology that answers these questions for
38	traditional software does not directly apply because agent traces lack
39	deterministic identifiers and runtime call-stack hierarchies.
40	% 为传统软件回答这些问题的火焰图 profiling 方法论不能直接适用，因为智能体 trace 缺乏确定性标识符和运行时调用栈层次。
41	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model}: uniform
42	\emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
43	\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
44	query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
45	% 我们提出语义 operation stack 模型：统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。
46	\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
47	for \emph{intent attribution} (deriving deterministic labels from
48	natural-language fields) and \emph{stack construction} (building
49	aggregation hierarchies from available fields), compiling local agent
50	traces into pprof-compatible profiles.
51	% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔算法的 profiler，包括意图归因（从自然语言字段派生确定性标签）和栈构造（从可用字段构建聚合层次），将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
52	On 325 real agent sessions, semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
53	system-effect weight that session-level views merge.
54	% 在 325 个真实智能体会话上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
55	On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
56	(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
57	problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
58	fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
59	% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。
60	\end{abstract}
61	
62	\maketitle
63	
64	%% ===================================================================
65	\section{Introduction}
66	\label{sec:intro}
67	
68	%% ¶1: Background + context
69	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
70	layers: high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
71	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
72	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
73	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
74	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
75	over weeks or months.
76	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
77	
78	%% ¶2: Problem
79	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
80	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions to determine
81	which categories of tasks consume the most token budget, where
82	failures concentrate across workflows, and which behavioral patterns
83	trigger unsafe system side-effects.
84	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
85	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
86	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
87	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
88	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
89	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
90	
91	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
92	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
93	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
94	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
95	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
96	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
97	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
98	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
99	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
100	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
101	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
102	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
103	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
104	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
105	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
106	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
107	
108	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
109	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
110	software.
111	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
112	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
113	single chart where width represents cost.
114	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
115	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
116	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
117	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
118	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
119	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
120	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
121	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
122	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
123	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
124	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
125	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
126	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
127	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
128	function calls produce stack frames.
129	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
130	
131	%% ¶5: Model
132	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
133	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
134	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
135	traces.
136	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
137	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
138	components.
139	% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
140	\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
141	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
142	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
143	objects.
144	% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。
145	\emph{Operation stacks} are ordered lists of fields chosen at query
146	time; each operation is projected to a frame sequence, and operations
147	with identical sequences merge, producing the folded-stack
148	representation that flame graphs visualize.
149	% Operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表；每个 operation 被投影到帧序列，具有相同序列的 operation 合并，产生火焰图可视化的折叠栈表示。
