\subsection{RQ4: What Is the Profiling Cost?}
% RQ4：分析开销是多少？

\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler, so it adds zero overhead to the agent's runtime.
% \sys 是离线事后分析器，对智能体运行时不增加任何开销。
The profiling cost is the time and resources spent after the session ends.
% 分析开销是会话结束后花费的时间和资源。

We re-execute 76 tracked profiling configurations twice (152 invocations) to measure cost and verify determinism.
% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 profiling configuration 两次（152 次调用）来测量开销并验证确定性。
All 76 specs produce byte-identical output across both runs.
% 全部 76 个 spec 在两次运行中产生字节相同的输出。
Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per spec (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
% 中位分析时间为每 spec 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
The slowest specs process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness-check specs all complete within 1.6\,s.
% 最慢的 spec 处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性检查 spec 全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
The full profile-spec composition path (operation files, query predicates, rank rules, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested configuration variants.
% 完整的 profiling configuration 组合路径（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名规则和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试的配置变体中保持确定性。

Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real trajectories, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per label using a local 3B-parameter model.
% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test labels).
% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
Because labels are cached, re-profiling the same trajectories with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。

\paragraph{Limitations.}
% 局限性。
The real-session data comes from a single multi-month development project, so the label distributions may not generalize to other domains.
% 真实会话数据来自单个多月开发项目，标签分布可能无法推广到其他领域。
Semantic accuracy of the intent-attribution backends on free-form prompts remains unevaluated because no available dataset simultaneously exposes free-form text and ground-truth semantic tags (as discussed in RQ3 above).
% 意图归因后端在自由形式提示词上的语义精度仍未评估，因为没有可用数据集同时暴露自由形式文本和真实语义标签（见 RQ3）。
The evaluation uses per-session grouping as a proxy for span-tree debugging tools, not a real OpenTelemetry or LangSmith trace import.
% 评估使用固定会话下钻作为 span 树调试工具的代理，而非真实的 OpenTelemetry 或 LangSmith trace 导入。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Related Work}
% 相关工作

Agent observability
tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}
focus on single-execution debugging.
% 智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}聚焦于单次执行调试。
Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} and
Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} cluster inputs or extract signals but
characterize input distributions, not resource attribution.
% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 和 Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 聚类输入或提取信号，但刻画的是输入分布而非资源归因。
AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}, TELBench~\cite{telbench},
AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}, TrajAD~\cite{trajad}, and
AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} perform per-trajectory fault
localization.
% AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}、TELBench~\cite{telbench}、AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}、TrajAD~\cite{trajad} 和 AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} 执行逐轨迹故障定位。
\sys complements all of these with category-level aggregate profiling
across trajectories.
% \sys 以跨轨迹的类别级聚合 profiling 补充所有这些工具。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Conclusion}
% 结论

Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
% 智能体可观测性需要性能分析，不仅仅是调试。
\sys shows that the semantic operation stack model, combined with pluggable intent attribution and stack construction algorithms, closes the aggregation gap for agent traces.
% \sys 表明，语义 operation stack 模型结合可插拔的意图归因和栈构造算法，填补了智能体 trace 的聚合缺口。
Scoring profiler output against hidden trajectory labels confirms that semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect cost that per-session views leave mixed, localizes labeled problems at 9.4\% inspection work versus flat summaries, and produces labels that agree with ground truth on 7/9 held-out datasets.
% 将分析器输出与隐藏轨迹标签评分确认，语义分析分离了超过 90\% 的混合系统副作用权重，以扁平摘要 9.4\% 的检查工作量定位标注问题，并在 7/9 保留数据集上产生与真实标签一致的标签。
Per-session grouping remains faster to a first positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary, and \sys supports both by including or excluding session fields in the stack query.
% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上更快找到首个正例，确认分析器和调试器是互补的，\sys 通过在栈查询中包含或排除会话字段同时支持两者。
Multi-project evaluation and trace-ecosystem integration are the most impactful next steps.
% 多项目评估和 trace 生态系统集成是最有影响力的下一步。

27	%% S1: Context (→¶1)
28	AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step

37	%% S3: Traditional profiling (→¶2+¶4)

39	attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
40	paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
41	tracing.

49	The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
50	and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
51	deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
52	aggregation possible.

56	adapts profiling to agent trajectories.

58	\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with

76	\section{Introduction}
77	\label{sec:intro}
78	
79	%% ¶1: Background + context
80	AI agents~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
81	% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
82	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
83	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为每次运行数小时、包含数千次交互的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累大量此类轨迹。
84	
85	%% ¶2: Problem
86	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
87	need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
88	interactions.
89	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
90	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
91	trigger unsafe system effects?
92	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
93	Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
94	trajectories~\cite{agentatlas,agentrewardbench}, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
95	per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
96	% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，在规模化时人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本越来越高。
97	In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
98	attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
99	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
100	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
101	
102	%% ¶3: Existing solutions

104	profiling (\S\ref{sec:background}).
105	% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
106	Some~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} organize events into
107	per-execution span trees, effective for diagnosing a single run but
108	unable to aggregate by semantic category.
109	% 一些工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将事件组织为按执行划分的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别聚合。
110	Others~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals} cluster inputs or
111	extract structured signals, but characterize \emph{input
112	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
113	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
114	token budget''), because tags at the request level do not propagate
115	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
116	% 另一些~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals}聚类输入或提取结构化信号，但刻画的是输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
117	
118	%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
119	Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
120	(\S\ref{sec:background}).
121	% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹具有挑战性（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
122	In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
123	Profiling is straightforward because function names are
124	deterministic and runtime call nesting provides the aggregation
125	hierarchy (\S\ref{sec:background}).
126	% 在传统软件中，负责实体是代码路径。Profiling 是直接的，因为函数名是确定性的，运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次，火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}可视化其结果。

133	% 智能体轨迹还缺乏使聚合成为可能的两个特性。

137	% 框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
138	Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
139	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way

Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per spec (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
% 中位分析时间为每 spec 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
The slowest specs process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness-check specs all complete within 1.6\,s.
% 最慢的 spec 处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性检查 spec 全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
The full profile-spec composition path (operation files, query predicates, rank rules, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested configuration variants.
% 完整的 profiling configuration 组合路径（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名规则和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试的配置变体中保持确定性。

Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real trajectories, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per label using a local 3B-parameter model.
% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test labels).
% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
Because labels are cached, re-profiling the same trajectories with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。

\paragraph{Limitations.}
% 局限性。
The real-session data comes from a single multi-month development project, so the label distributions may not generalize to other domains.
% 真实会话数据来自单个多月开发项目，标签分布可能无法推广到其他领域。
Semantic accuracy of the intent-attribution backends on free-form prompts remains unevaluated because no available dataset simultaneously exposes free-form text and ground-truth semantic tags (as discussed in RQ3 above).
% 意图归因后端在自由形式提示词上的语义精度仍未评估，因为没有可用数据集同时暴露自由形式文本和真实语义标签（见 RQ3）。
The evaluation uses per-session grouping as a proxy for span-tree debugging tools, not a real OpenTelemetry or LangSmith trace import.
% 评估使用固定会话下钻作为 span 树调试工具的代理，而非真实的 OpenTelemetry 或 LangSmith trace 导入。

23	
24	\title{AgentProf: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}
25	
26	\begin{abstract}
27	%% S1: Context (→¶1)
28	AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
29	activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
30	users, tools, and system resources.
31	% AI 智能体编排长时间运行的多步骤活动，涉及与用户、工具和系统资源的数千到数百万次交互。
32	%% S2: Need (→¶2)
33	To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to
34	determine which task categories consume the most budget, where
35	failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe effects.
36	% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要确定哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用。
37	%% S3: Traditional profiling (→¶2+¶4)
38	To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, profiling
39	attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
40	paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
41	tracing.
42	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体（如代码路径），而非单次执行调试或 tracing。
43	%% S4: Gap (→¶2+¶3)
44	Yet existing agent observability tools are mainly for debugging and
45	tracing instead of profiling.
46	% 然而现有智能体可观测性工具主要用于调试和 tracing，而非 profiling。
47	%% S5: Agent challenge (→¶4)
48	Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
49	The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
50	and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
51	deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
52	aggregation possible.
53	% 智能体行为与代码执行有根本不同。负责实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段），而非代码路径，且智能体轨迹缺乏使聚合成为可能的确定性标识符和结构层次。
54	%% S6: Model (→¶5)
55	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} that
56	adapts profiling to agent trajectories.
57	Uniform \emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
58	\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
59	query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
60	% 我们提出首个将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹的语义 operation stack 模型。统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。
61	%% S7: System (→¶6)
62	\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
63	for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},
64	compiling local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles.
65	% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造算法的 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
66	%% S8: Results (→¶6)
67	On real trajectories and public datasets, our evaluation shows that
68	semantic profiling effectively attributes cost and locates problems
69	across agent trajectories.
70	% 在真实轨迹和公开数据集上，我们的评估表明语义 profiling 能有效地跨智能体轨迹归因开销和定位问题。
71	\end{abstract}

74	
75	%% ===================================================================
76	\section{Introduction}
77	\label{sec:intro}
78	
79	%% ¶1: Background + context
80	AI agents~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
81	% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
82	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
83	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为每次运行数小时、包含数千次交互的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累大量此类轨迹。
84	
85	%% ¶2: Problem
86	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
87	need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
88	interactions.
89	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
90	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
91	trigger unsafe system effects?
92	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
93	Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
94	trajectories~\cite{agentatlas,agentrewardbench}, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
95	per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
96	% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，在规模化时人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本越来越高。
97	In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
98	attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
99	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
100	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
101	
102	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
103	Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
104	profiling (\S\ref{sec:background}).
105	% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
106	Some~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} organize events into
107	per-execution span trees, effective for diagnosing a single run but
108	unable to aggregate by semantic category.
109	% 一些工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将事件组织为按执行划分的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别聚合。
110	Others~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals} cluster inputs or
111	extract structured signals, but characterize \emph{input
112	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
113	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
114	token budget''), because tags at the request level do not propagate
115	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
116	% 另一些~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals}聚类输入或提取结构化信号，但刻画的是输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
117	
118	%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
119	Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
120	(\S\ref{sec:background}).
121	% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹具有挑战性（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
122	In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
123	Profiling is straightforward because function names are
124	deterministic and runtime call nesting provides the aggregation
125	hierarchy (\S\ref{sec:background}).
126	% 在传统软件中，负责实体是代码路径。Profiling 是直接的，因为函数名是确定性的，运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次，火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}可视化其结果。
127	Agent behavior differs fundamentally.
128	To answer the questions above, the responsible entities need to be
129	semantic categories such as task intent and tool operation, not code
130	paths.
131	% 智能体行为有根本不同。要回答上述问题，负责实体需要是语义类别（如任务意图和工具操作），而非代码路径。
132	Agent trajectories also lack the two properties that make aggregation possible.
133	% 智能体轨迹还缺乏使聚合成为可能的两个特性。
134	Prompts are natural language, and two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
135	% 提示词是自然语言，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串。
136	Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}) describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
137	% 框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
138	Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
139	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
140	function calls produce stack frames.
141	% 智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次，因为提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
142	
143	\begin{figure*}[t]
144	\centering
145	\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-tokens.png}\\[2pt]
146	\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-time.png}\\[2pt]
147	\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-files.png}
148	\caption{Semantic flame graphs of 325 real agent trajectories under
149	three views. \emph{Top (tokens):} width represents token count.
150	\emph{Middle (time):} width represents wall-clock duration.
151	\emph{Bottom (files):} width represents file-operation count.
152	All three are produced from the same operations by changing only the
153	stack fields and weight function (Table~\ref{tab:views}).}
154	\Description{Three wide flame graphs showing token budget, time, and
155	file-access distributions across trajectories and prompt categories.}
156	\label{fig:flamegraph}
157	\end{figure*}
158	
159	%% ¶5: Model
160	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
161	methodology (define units, assign stable tags, construct
162	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
163	trajectories.
164	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论（定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈）可以迁移到智能体轨迹。
165	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
166	components.
167	% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
168	\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
169	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
170	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
171	objects.
172	% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。
173	\emph{Operation stacks} are ordered lists of fields chosen at query
174	time.
175	% Operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表。
176	Each operation is projected to a frame sequence, and operations
177	with identical sequences merge, producing the folded-stack
178	representation that flame graphs visualize
179	(Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}).
180	% 每个 operation 被投影到帧序列，具有相同序列的 operation 合并，产生火焰图可视化的折叠栈表示。
181	Different field selections answer different questions (by task
182	category, by execution phase, by session, or by action type) from
183	the same data.
184	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题（按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话或按操作类型）。
185	
186	%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
187	We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
188	local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles
189	(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
190	% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
191	Two pluggable algorithm frameworks enrich the model.
192	% 两个可插拔算法框架丰富此模型。
193	\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality tags from natural-language fields via regex rules, a local LLM tagger, or unsupervised clustering.
194	% 意图归因通过正则规则、本地 LLM 标注器或无监督聚类从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签。
195	This gives agents the stable tags that traditional profiling gets
196	for free from function names.
197	% 这为智能体提供了传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标签。
198	\emph{Stack construction} builds aggregation hierarchies from
199	available fields, either from a user-specified field list or by
200	automatically detecting boundaries between distinct work phases.
201	% 栈构造从可用字段构建聚合层次，可通过用户指定的字段列表或自动检测不同工作阶段之间的边界。
202	On 325 real Codex and Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system
203	observations), semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
204	system-effect cost that per-session views cannot attribute to task
205	categories.
206	% 在 325 个真实 Codex 和 Claude 轨迹（183,714 个系统观测）上，语义 profiling 分离了按会话视图无法归因到任务类别的超过 90\% 的系统副作用开销。
207	On four public datasets (34{,}539 operations) where the correct
208	annotations are known but hidden from the profiler, ranked groups locate
209	real problems at 9.4\% inspection work, with 45\% fewer groups than
210	per-session grouping.
211	% 在四个公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，正确标签已知但对 profiler 隐藏，排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位真实问题，比按会话分组减少 45\% 的分组数。
212	Derived tags agree with ground truth on 7 of 9 held-out datasets.
213	% 派生标签在 9 个保留数据集中的 7 个上与真实标签一致。
214	
215	%% ¶7: Contributions
216	This paper makes three contributions:
217	% 本文做出三项贡献：
218	
219	\begin{enumerate}
220	\item \textbf{Semantic operation stack model.}
221	  We identify the missing profiling layer in agent observability and
222	  propose a model of uniform operations and query-time operation
223	  stacks (\S\ref{sec:background}--\S\ref{sec:design}).
224	% 语义 operation stack 模型。识别智能体可观测性中缺失的 profiling 层，提出统一 operation 和查询时 operation stack 的模型。
225	\item \textbf{System: \sys.}
226	  A profiler that implements this model with pluggable intent
227	  attribution and stack construction, producing pprof-compatible
228	  output (\S\ref{sec:impl}).
229	% 系统：\sys。实现此模型的 profiler，具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造，产生 pprof 兼容输出。
230	\item \textbf{Evaluation.}
231	  We evaluate profiler output against hidden ground-truth trajectory
232	  annotations, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in CPU profiler
233	  evaluation, on 325 real trajectories and 4 public datasets
234	  (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
235	% 隐藏标签评估。将 profiler 输出与隐藏的真实轨迹标签评分，类似于在 CPU profiler 评估中注入已知瓶颈，在 325 个真实会话和 4 个公开数据集上验证。
236	\end{enumerate}
237	
238	%% ===================================================================
239	\section{Background and Motivation}
240	\label{sec:background}
241	
242	\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
243	% AI 智能体
244	
245	A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
246	% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
247	At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
248	calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
249	% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
250	Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
251	process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
252	% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
253	A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
254	cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
255	time.
256	% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。
257	
258	\subsection{System Profiling}
259	% 系统 Profiling
260	
261	Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by
262	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and
263	tracing.
264	% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
265	In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
266	a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
267	sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
268	stacks.
269	% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
270	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
271	visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
272	cost.
273	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
274	Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
275	and derived events.
276	% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
277	These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
278	deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
279	% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
280	Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
281	label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
282	stack that agent trajectories do not have.
283	% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。
284	
285	\subsection{Challenges for Agent Profiling}
286	% 智能体 Profiling 的挑战
287	
288	Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent
289	events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
290	run.
291	% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
292	AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers
293	by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM
294	traffic, but the resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
295	% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。
296	
297	
298	Adapting profiling to agent trajectories faces two core challenges.
299	% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹面临两个核心挑战。
300	The first is that the responsible entities differ.
301	% 第一个挑战是负责实体不同。
302	In traditional software, profiling attributes cost to code paths, but
303	in agent trajectories the relevant entities are semantic categories
304	such as task intent and workflow phase.
305	% 在传统软件中，profiling 将开销归因到代码路径，但在智能体轨迹中，相关实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段）。
306	Existing tools do not capture these categories: sessions are
307	boundaries, not categories (a single session may mix review,
308	debugging, and refactoring phases), and span
309	names~\cite{otel,openinference} describe mechanisms
310	(\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}), not user intent
311	(\texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}).
312	% 现有工具不捕获这些类别：会话是边界而非类别（单个会话可能混合 review、debugging 和 refactoring 阶段），span 名称~\cite{otel,openinference}描述机制（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}），而非用户意图（\texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}）。
313	The second challenge is that agent trajectories lack the two
314	properties that make traditional aggregation possible:
315	prompts are natural language without deterministic identifiers, and
316	agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy.
317	% 第二个挑战是智能体轨迹缺乏使传统聚合成为可能的两个特性：提示词是没有确定性标识符的自然语言，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次。
318	As a result, a common system effect like running a test suite may
319	appear thousands of times across trajectories, but without semantic
320	tags no tool can attribute these executions to the task categories
321	that triggered them.
322	% 因此，像运行测试套件这样的常见系统副作用可能在轨迹中出现数千次，但没有语义标签，任何工具都无法将这些执行归因到触发它们的任务类别。
323	We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
324	% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。
325	
326	\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
327	% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求
328	
329	These observations yield three design requirements:
330	% 这些观察得出三个设计需求：
331	
332	\begin{description}
333	\item[R1: Uniform record type.]
334	Agent activities mix prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, GUI actions, process events, and benchmark annotations.
335	% 智能体活动混合了提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、GUI 操作、进程事件和基准标签。
336	The profiler needs a single record type that can represent all of them without type-specific objects.
337	% 分析器需要一种能表示所有这些活动的单一记录类型，无需特定类型的对象。
338	\item[R2: Query-time aggregation.]
339	The same data must support multiple aggregation shapes (by task, phase, action, session, or dataset) without rebuilding the input.
340	% 同一数据必须支持多种聚合形状（按任务、阶段、操作、会话或数据集），无需重建输入。
341	Sessions and spans must be fields, not fixed hierarchy nodes.
342	% 会话和 span 必须是字段，而非固定层次节点。
343	\item[R3: Deterministic tags for folding.]
344	Free-form prompts must be mapped to short, stable, repeatable tags before folding.
345	% 自由形式的提示词必须在折叠前映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签。
346	This \emph{intent attribution} step has no analogue in CPU profiling, where function names are already deterministic.
347	% 这一意图归因步骤在 CPU 性能分析中没有对应物，因为函数名已经是确定性的。
348	\end{description}
349	
350	%% ===================================================================
351	\section{Design}
352	% 设计
353	\label{sec:design}
354	
355	The three requirements (a uniform record type, query-time aggregation, and deterministic tags for folding) drive the design.
356	% 三个需求（统一记录类型、查询时聚合和用于折叠的确定性标签）驱动了设计。
357	The semantic operation stack model has two components, operations (\S\ref{sec:ops}) and operation stacks (\S\ref{sec:stacks}), satisfying R1 and R2.
358	% 语义 operation stack 模型有两个组件——operation（\S\ref{sec:ops}）和 operation stack（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）——满足 R1 和 R2。
359	Two pluggable algorithm frameworks enrich the model. Intent attribution (\S\ref{sec:intent}) satisfies R3 by deriving deterministic tags, and stack construction (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) builds aggregation hierarchies from available fields.
360	% 两个可插拔算法框架丰富此模型。意图归因（\S\ref{sec:intent}）通过派生确定性标签满足 R3，栈构造（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）从可用字段构建聚合层次。
361	The profiling pipeline has five stages: (1)~parse raw trajectories into operations, (2)~enrich operations via intent attribution or mapping rules, (3)~filter by a user-specified predicate, (4)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (5)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
362	% 分析管线有五个阶段：(1) 将原始 trace 解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图归因或映射规则丰富 operation，(3) 按用户指定的谓词过滤，(4) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(5) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。
363	
364	\subsection{Semantic Operation Stack Model}
365	% 语义 Operation Stack 模型
366	\label{sec:ops}
367	
368	%% ¶1: Operations
369	Because agent activities span both the intent and system-effect
370	layers described in \S\ref{sec:background}, a profiler should not
371	distinguish between them in the data representation.
372	% 由于智能体活动跨越 \S\ref{sec:background} 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在数据表示层面区分它们。
373	\sys therefore represents every activity as a single abstraction, the
374	\operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive
375	measures.
376	% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。
377	Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project},
378	\texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag},
379	\texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain},
380	\texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count,
381	duration, occurrence count).
382	% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、出现次数）。
383	A prompt, an LLM call, a tool invocation, a file read, a GUI click,
384	and a process event are all operation records that differ only in
385	which fields are populated.
386	% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是 operation 记录，仅在填充的字段上有所不同。
387	
388	%% ¶2: Operation Stacks
389	\label{sec:stacks}
390	An \opstack is an ordered list of fields chosen at query time.
391	% 一个 operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表。
392	Given a stack specification $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$, each
393	operation $o$ is projected to a frame sequence
394	$\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$.
395	% 给定栈规范 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$，每个 operation $o$ 被投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$。
396	Operations with identical frame sequences are merged and their
397	weights are summed.
398	% 具有相同帧序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
399	Unlike CPU profiling, where the call stack is determined by
400	execution, the stack is determined by the query.
401	% 与 CPU 分析中调用栈由执行决定不同，这里的栈由查询决定。
402	The same operations can be folded as a flat task summary, a
403	per-session tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a
404	dataset-native trajectory, and changing the fields changes the
405	aggregation without changing the data.
406	% 同一组 operation 可以折叠为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或数据集原生轨迹，改变字段即改变聚合方式而无需改变数据。
407	Sessions and spans are optional operation fields, not structural
408	skeleton nodes, so the same data supports both debugging views
409	(include \texttt{session}) and aggregate profiling views (exclude
410	it).
411	% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段而非结构性骨架节点，因此同一数据既支持调试视图（包含 \texttt{session}）也支持聚合 profiling 视图（排除它）。
412	A view is a triple $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$: a predicate
413	$\varphi$ selects which operations participate, a stack function
414	$\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ maps each operation to its frame
415	sequence, and a weight function $w$ assigns a nonnegative measure.
416	% 一个视图是三元组 $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$：谓词 $\varphi$ 选择参与的 operation，栈函数 $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation 映射到其帧序列，权重函数 $w$ 赋予非负度量。
417	Four built-in defaults (Table~\ref{tab:views}) answer common
418	questions.
419	% 四个内置默认视图（Table~\ref{tab:views}）回答常见问题。
420	
421	\begin{table}[t]
422	\centering\small
423	\caption{Built-in views. Each shares the same operation set
424	but selects different activities, stack structures, and weights.}

432	\texttt{files} & File-effect ops & event count & Repo coverage? \\

449	\subsection{Algorithms}
450	% 算法
451	\label{sec:intent}
452	
453	\paragraph{Intent attribution.}
454	% 意图归因。
455	Intent attribution maps free-form prompts to short, stable,
456	deterministic tags, giving agent trajectories the stable
457	identifiers that traditional profiling gets for free from function
458	names (\S\ref{sec:background}).
459	% 意图归因将自由形式的提示词映射为短小、稳定、确定性的标签，为智能体轨迹提供传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标识符（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
460	The framework supports three pluggable backends.
461	% 该框架支持三种可插拔后端。
462	Regex rules are the production default: rules have the form
463	\texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}, are evaluated in order (first match wins),
464	and the developer iterates with \sys until the unmatched rate drops
465	below 5\%, typically in 5--10 rounds.
466	% 正则规则是生产环境默认：规则格式为 \texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}，按顺序求值（首个匹配胜出），开发者与 \sys 迭代直到未匹配率降至 5\% 以下，通常需要 5--10 轮。
467	A local LLM tagger (e.g., a quantized 3B-parameter model via llama.cpp)
468	generates a single-word tag per prompt with grammar-constrained
469	decoding (forcing output to match a predefined token grammar) and caching.
470	% 本地 LLM 标注器（如通过 llama.cpp 运行的量化 3B 参数模型）通过语法约束解码（强制输出匹配预定义 token 语法）和缓存为每个提示词生成单词标签。
471	Unsupervised clustering via TF-IDF and K-Means discovers
472	natural prompt groups without predefined rules, feeding rule
473	authoring.
474	% 通过 TF-IDF 和 K-Means 的无监督聚类在没有预定义规则的情况下发现自然提示词分组，为规则编写提供输入。
475	For structured traces where action types and quality annotations are
476	explicit fields, mapping rules derive new fields from existing
477	ones (e.g., \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}).
478	% 对于操作类型和质量标注是显式字段的结构化 trace，映射规则从现有字段派生新字段（如 \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}）。
479	All backends are pluggable, and a profiling configuration records the
480	complete analysis setup for deterministic replay.
481	% 所有后端都是可插拔的，profiling configuration 记录完整的分析配置以实现确定性重放。
482	
483	\paragraph{Stack construction.}
484	% 栈构造。
485	Stack construction builds aggregation hierarchies from
486	available fields.
487	% 栈构造从可用字段构建聚合层次。
488	When users supply a ordered list of fields, the projection is direct.
489	% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
490	When no chain is supplied, \sys can induce operation stacks
491	automatically by scoring adjacent operations for semantic shifts,
492	field changes, and partition coherence, then cutting at boundaries
493	where the evidence is strongest.
494	% 当不提供有序字段列表时，\sys 可以通过对相邻 operation 评分语义转移、字段变化和分区一致性来自动诱导 operation stack，然后在证据最强的边界处切分。
495	The induced stacks have variable depth, and a configurable depth cap
496	controls the granularity.
497	% 诱导的栈具有可变深度，可配置的深度上限控制粒度。
498	This mode produces coarser groups than hand-specified stacks but
499	requires no domain knowledge, making it useful for initial
500	exploration (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
501	% 此模式产生比手动指定栈更粗的分组，但不需要领域知识，适用于初始探索（\S\ref{sec:eval}）。
502

504	\section{Implementation}
505	% 实现
506	\label{sec:impl}
507	
508	\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler implemented as a Rust CLI (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
509	% \sys 是一个离线、事后分析器，实现为 Rust CLI（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
510	It reads recorded traces, not live events.
511	% 它读取记录的 trace，而非实时事件。
512	The \texttt{agent-session} crate reads Codex and Claude Code local JSONL history files and reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and their triggered file and network effects.
513	% \texttt{agent-session} crate 读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 本地 JSONL 历史文件，重建提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用及其触发的文件和网络副作用。
514	Each prompt opens a span.
515	% 每个提示词打开一个 span。
516	LLM calls, tool calls, and system effects within that span inherit its semantic tag, connecting intent to system behavior without runtime instrumentation.
517	% 该 span 内的 LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用继承其语义标签，无需运行时插桩即可连接意图与系统行为。
518	Public benchmark datasets enter as operation JSONL with mapping rules deriving fields before stack construction.
519	% 公开基准数据集以 operation JSONL 形式进入，映射规则在栈构建之前派生字段。
520	Standard Chrome Trace Event format can also be imported, with non-\sys protocol fields preserved as operation fields.
521	% 标准 Chrome Trace Event 格式也可导入，非 \sys 协议字段作为 operation 字段保留。
522	
523	Output formats include pprof protobuf (compatible with \texttt{go tool pprof -http}), folded-stack text (compatible with \texttt{flamegraph.pl}), standalone SVG flame graphs, and JSON summaries.
524	% 输出格式包括 pprof protobuf（兼容 \texttt{go tool pprof -http}）、折叠栈文本（兼容 \texttt{flamegraph.pl}）、独立 SVG 火焰图和 JSON 摘要。
525	Operations can also be exported as standard Chrome Trace Event JSON and re-imported with byte-identical folded output, enabling interoperability with trace viewers such as Perfetto.
526	% Operation 也可以导出为标准 Chrome Trace Event JSON 并重新导入，折叠输出字节相同，支持与 Perfetto 等 trace 查看器的互操作。
527	All outputs are deterministic given the same input and profiling configuration.
528	% 在相同输入和 profiling configuration 下，所有输出都是确定性的。
529	
530	\sys is the offline profiling component of the AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} observability framework.
531	% \sys 是 AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 可观测性框架的离线分析组件。
532	AgentSight provides real-time eBPF-based capture of SSL traffic, process events, and file/network effects.
533	% AgentSight 提供基于 eBPF 的实时 SSL 流量、进程事件和文件/网络副作用捕获。
534	\sys aggregates the recorded traces into semantic profiles, so the two are complementary: AgentSight answers ``what happened during this run'' (debugging), and \sys answers ``where did the budget go across runs'' (profiling).
535	% \sys 将记录的 trace 聚合为语义概要，因此两者互补：AgentSight 回答"这次运行发生了什么"（调试），\sys 回答"预算跨运行花在了哪里"（分析）。

538	\section{Evaluation}
539	% 评估
540	\label{sec:eval}
541	
542	We use two classes of data.
543	% 我们使用两类数据。
544	\textbf{Real agent trajectories}: 325 readable local trajectories (198~Codex, 50~Claude, 77~Claude subagent) from a multi-month development project, containing 183{,}714 system observations.
545	% 真实智能体会话：来自一个多月开发项目的 325 个可读本地会话（198 个 Codex、50 个 Claude、77 个 Claude 子智能体），包含 183,714 个系统观测。
546	\textbf{Public annotated traces}: 15 families of real agent or human executions, totaling 47{,}590 operations through mapping rules.
547	% 公开标注 trace：15 个真实智能体或人类执行的家族，通过映射规则共计 47,590 个 operation。
548	These cover web agents (WebLINX~\cite{weblinx}, Mind2Web~\cite{mind2web}, AgentTrek~\cite{agenttrek}, WebShop~\cite{webshop}), API agents (API-Bank~\cite{apibank}, ToolBench~\cite{toolbench}, tau-bench~\cite{taubench}), coding agents (SWE-agent~\cite{sweagent}), and mobile/GUI agents (AndroidCtrl~\cite{androidcontrol}, GUI-Odyssey~\cite{guiodyssey}, ScaleCUA~\cite{scalecua}).
549	% 涵盖 web 智能体（WebLINX、Mind2Web、AgentTrek、WebShop）、API 智能体（API-Bank、ToolBench、tau-bench）、编码智能体（SWE-agent）和移动/GUI 智能体（AndroidCtrl、GUI-Odyssey、ScaleCUA）。
550	Four families with ground-truth quality annotations (AgentRewardBench~\cite{agentrewardbench}, SATraj-OS~\cite{safactory}, AgentNet~\cite{agentnet}, OSWorld-Human~\cite{osworldhuman}) provide hidden annotations for RQ2.
551	% 四个具有真实质量标注的家族（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet、OSWorld-Human）为 RQ2 提供隐藏标签。
552	We measure semantic separation via the mixed-weight percentage defined in RQ1.
553	% 我们通过 RQ1 中定义的混合权重百分比测量语义分离度。
554	For localization quality (RQ2), we use average precision (AP, the area under the precision-recall curve when groups are ranked by suspected problem density), recall at various inspection budgets, and work-to-first-positive (the fraction of groups inspected before finding one positive).

820	All 76 specs produce byte-identical output across both runs.
821	% 全部 76 个 spec 在两次运行中产生字节相同的输出。
822	Median profiling time is 1.6\,s per spec (p95 2.8\,s, max 4.3\,s), and median output size is 37.5\,KB.
823	% 中位分析时间为每 spec 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。
824	The slowest specs process views with over 600 unique stacks, while the 60 robustness-check specs all complete within 1.6\,s.
825	% 最慢的 spec 处理超过 600 个唯一栈的视图，而 60 个稳健性检查 spec 全部在 1.6 秒内完成。
826	The full profile-spec composition path (operation files, query predicates, rank rules, and stack depth) stays deterministic across all 12 tested configuration variants.
827	% 完整的 profiling configuration 组合路径（operation 文件、查询谓词、排名规则和栈深度）在所有 12 个测试的配置变体中保持确定性。
828	
829	Intent attribution adds a one-time cost for new prompts.
830	% 意图归因对新提示词增加一次性开销。
831	Of 118{,}021 tag requests on 325 real trajectories, 70\% are cache hits (zero cost), and the remaining 35{,}136 new calls complete at p95 latency of 31\,ms per label using a local 3B-parameter model.
832	% 在 325 个真实会话的 118,021 个标注请求中，70\% 为缓存命中（零开销），其余 35,136 个新调用使用本地 3B 参数模型以 p95 延迟 31 毫秒/标签完成。
833	Grammar-constrained decoding ensures 100\% syntax validity (2{,}700/2{,}700 test labels).
834	% 语法约束解码确保 100\% 语法有效性（2,700/2,700 测试标签）。
835	Because labels are cached, re-profiling the same trajectories with different stack fields or predicates incurs no additional LLM calls.
836	% 因为标签被缓存，用不同栈字段或谓词重新分析相同会话不产生额外 LLM 调用。
837	
838	\paragraph{Limitations.}
839	% 局限性。
840	The real-session data comes from a single multi-month development project, so the label distributions may not generalize to other domains.
841	% 真实会话数据来自单个多月开发项目，标签分布可能无法推广到其他领域。
842	Semantic accuracy of the intent-attribution backends on free-form prompts remains unevaluated because no available dataset simultaneously exposes free-form text and ground-truth semantic tags (as discussed in RQ3 above).
843	% 意图归因后端在自由形式提示词上的语义精度仍未评估，因为没有可用数据集同时暴露自由形式文本和真实语义标签（见 RQ3）。
844	The evaluation uses per-session grouping as a proxy for span-tree debugging tools, not a real OpenTelemetry or LangSmith trace import.
845	% 评估使用固定会话下钻作为 span 树调试工具的代理，而非真实的 OpenTelemetry 或 LangSmith trace 导入。
846	
847	%% ===================================================================
848	\section{Related Work}
849	% 相关工作
850	
851	Agent observability
852	tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}
853	focus on single-execution debugging.
854	% 智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}聚焦于单次执行调试。
855	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} and
856	Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} cluster inputs or extract signals but
857	characterize input distributions, not resource attribution.
858	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 和 Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 聚类输入或提取信号，但刻画的是输入分布而非资源归因。
859	AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}, TELBench~\cite{telbench},
860	AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}, TrajAD~\cite{trajad}, and
861	AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} perform per-trajectory fault
862	localization.
863	% AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}、TELBench~\cite{telbench}、AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}、TrajAD~\cite{trajad} 和 AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} 执行逐轨迹故障定位。
864	\sys complements all of these with category-level aggregate profiling
865	across trajectories.
866	% \sys 以跨轨迹的类别级聚合 profiling 补充所有这些工具。
867	
868	%% ===================================================================
869	\section{Conclusion}
870	% 结论
871	
872	Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
873	% 智能体可观测性需要性能分析，不仅仅是调试。
874	\sys shows that the semantic operation stack model, combined with pluggable intent attribution and stack construction algorithms, closes the aggregation gap for agent traces.
875	% \sys 表明，语义 operation stack 模型结合可插拔的意图归因和栈构造算法，填补了智能体 trace 的聚合缺口。
876	Scoring profiler output against hidden trajectory labels confirms that semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect cost that per-session views leave mixed, localizes labeled problems at 9.4\% inspection work versus flat summaries, and produces labels that agree with ground truth on 7/9 held-out datasets.
877	% 将分析器输出与隐藏轨迹标签评分确认，语义分析分离了超过 90\% 的混合系统副作用权重，以扁平摘要 9.4\% 的检查工作量定位标注问题，并在 7/9 保留数据集上产生与真实标签一致的标签。
878	Per-session grouping remains faster to a first positive on 4/6 tasks, confirming that profilers and debuggers are complementary, and \sys supports both by including or excluding session fields in the stack query.
879	% 固定会话下钻在 4/6 任务上更快找到首个正例，确认分析器和调试器是互补的，\sys 通过在栈查询中包含或排除会话字段同时支持两者。
880	Multi-project evaluation and trace-ecosystem integration are the most impactful next steps.
881	% 多项目评估和 trace 生态系统集成是最有影响力的下一步。
882	
883	\bibliographystyle{ACM-Reference-Format}
884	\bibliography{references}
885	
886	\end{document}

\documentclass[sigconf]{acmart}

\setcopyright{none}
\settopmatter{printacmref=false}
\renewcommand\footnotetextcopyrightpermission[1]{}
\pagestyle{plain}

\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{xspace}
\usepackage{url}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning}

\newcommand{\sys}{\textsc{AgentProf}\xspace}
\newcommand{\operation}{\texttt{operation}\xspace}
\newcommand{\opstack}{\texttt{operation stack}\xspace}

\begin{document}

\title{AgentProf: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}

\begin{abstract}
%% S1: Context (→¶1)
AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
users, tools, and system resources.
% AI 智能体编排长时间运行的多步骤活动，涉及与用户、工具和系统资源的数千到数百万次交互。
%% S2: Need (→¶2)
To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to
determine which task categories consume the most budget, where
failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe effects.
% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要确定哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用。
%% S3: Traditional profiling (→¶2+¶4)
To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, profiling
attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
tracing.
% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体（如代码路径），而非单次执行调试或 tracing。
%% S4: Gap (→¶2+¶3)
Yet existing agent observability tools are mainly for debugging and
tracing instead of profiling.
% 然而现有智能体可观测性工具主要用于调试和 tracing，而非 profiling。
%% S5: Agent challenge (→¶4)
Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
aggregation possible.
% 智能体行为与代码执行有根本不同。负责实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段），而非代码路径，且智能体轨迹缺乏使聚合成为可能的确定性标识符和结构层次。
%% S6: Model (→¶5)
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} that
adapts profiling to agent trajectories.
Uniform \emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
% 我们提出首个将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹的语义 operation stack 模型。统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。
%% S7: System (→¶6)
\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},
compiling local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles.
% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造算法的 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
%% S8: Results (→¶6)
On real trajectories and public datasets, our evaluation shows that
semantic profiling effectively attributes cost and locates problems
across agent trajectories.
% 在真实轨迹和公开数据集上，我们的评估表明语义 profiling 能有效地跨智能体轨迹归因开销和定位问题。
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

%% ===================================================================
\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

%% ¶1: Background + context
AI agents~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为每次运行数小时、包含数千次交互的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累大量此类轨迹。

%% ¶2: Problem
To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
interactions.
Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
trigger unsafe system effects?
% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
trajectories~\cite{agentatlas,agentrewardbench}, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，在规模化时人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本越来越高。
In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。

%% ¶3: Existing solutions
Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
profiling (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
Some~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} organize events into
per-execution span trees, effective for diagnosing a single run but
unable to aggregate by semantic category.
% 一些工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将事件组织为按执行划分的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别聚合。
Others~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals} cluster inputs or
extract structured signals, but characterize \emph{input
distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
token budget''), because tags at the request level do not propagate
to downstream tool calls and system effects.
% 另一些~\cite{datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals}聚类输入或提取结构化信号，但刻画的是输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
(\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹具有挑战性（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
Profiling is straightforward because function names are
deterministic and runtime call nesting provides the aggregation
hierarchy (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 在传统软件中，负责实体是代码路径。Profiling 是直接的，因为函数名是确定性的，运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次，火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}可视化其结果。
Agent behavior differs fundamentally.
To answer the questions above, the responsible entities need to be
semantic categories such as task intent and tool operation, not code
paths.
% 智能体行为有根本不同。要回答上述问题，负责实体需要是语义类别（如任务意图和工具操作），而非代码路径。
Agent trajectories also lack the two properties that make aggregation possible.
% 智能体轨迹还缺乏使聚合成为可能的两个特性。
Prompts are natural language, and two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
% 提示词是自然语言，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串。
Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}) describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
% 框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
function calls produce stack frames.
% 智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次，因为提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-tokens.png}\\[2pt]
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-time.png}\\[2pt]
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-files.png}
\caption{Semantic flame graphs of 325 real agent trajectories under
three views. \emph{Top (tokens):} width represents token count.
\emph{Middle (time):} width represents wall-clock duration.
\emph{Bottom (files):} width represents file-operation count.
All three are produced from the same operations by changing only the
stack fields and weight function (Table~\ref{tab:views}).}
\Description{Three wide flame graphs showing token budget, time, and
file-access distributions across trajectories and prompt categories.}
\label{fig:flamegraph}
\end{figure*}

%% ¶5: Model
Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
methodology (define units, assign stable tags, construct
aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
trajectories.
% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论（定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈）可以迁移到智能体轨迹。
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
components.
% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
objects.
% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。
\emph{Operation stacks} are ordered lists of fields chosen at query
time.
% Operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表。
Each operation is projected to a frame sequence, and operations
with identical sequences merge, producing the folded-stack
representation that flame graphs visualize
(Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}).
% 每个 operation 被投影到帧序列，具有相同序列的 operation 合并，产生火焰图可视化的折叠栈表示。
Different field selections answer different questions (by task
category, by execution phase, by session, or by action type) from
the same data.
% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题（按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话或按操作类型）。

%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles
(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
Two pluggable algorithm frameworks enrich the model.
% 两个可插拔算法框架丰富此模型。
\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality tags from natural-language fields via regex rules, a local LLM tagger, or unsupervised clustering.
% 意图归因通过正则规则、本地 LLM 标注器或无监督聚类从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签。
This gives agents the stable tags that traditional profiling gets
for free from function names.
% 这为智能体提供了传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标签。
\emph{Stack construction} builds aggregation hierarchies from
available fields, either from a user-specified field list or by
automatically detecting boundaries between distinct work phases.
% 栈构造从可用字段构建聚合层次，可通过用户指定的字段列表或自动检测不同工作阶段之间的边界。
On 325 real Codex and Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system
observations), semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
system-effect cost that per-session views cannot attribute to task
categories.
% 在 325 个真实 Codex 和 Claude 轨迹（183,714 个系统观测）上，语义 profiling 分离了按会话视图无法归因到任务类别的超过 90\% 的系统副作用开销。
On four public datasets (34{,}539 operations) where the correct
annotations are known but hidden from the profiler, ranked groups locate
real problems at 9.4\% inspection work, with 45\% fewer groups than
per-session grouping.
% 在四个公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，正确标签已知但对 profiler 隐藏，排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位真实问题，比按会话分组减少 45\% 的分组数。
Derived tags agree with ground truth on 7 of 9 held-out datasets.
% 派生标签在 9 个保留数据集中的 7 个上与真实标签一致。

%% ¶7: Contributions
This paper makes three contributions:
% 本文做出三项贡献：

\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Semantic operation stack model.}
  We identify the missing profiling layer in agent observability and
  propose a model of uniform operations and query-time operation
  stacks (\S\ref{sec:background}--\S\ref{sec:design}).
% 语义 operation stack 模型。识别智能体可观测性中缺失的 profiling 层，提出统一 operation 和查询时 operation stack 的模型。
\item \textbf{System: \sys.}
  A profiler that implements this model with pluggable intent
  attribution and stack construction, producing pprof-compatible
  output (\S\ref{sec:impl}).
% 系统：\sys。实现此模型的 profiler，具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造，产生 pprof 兼容输出。
\item \textbf{Evaluation.}
  We evaluate profiler output against hidden ground-truth trajectory
  annotations, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in CPU profiler
  evaluation, on 325 real trajectories and 4 public datasets
  (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 隐藏标签评估。将 profiler 输出与隐藏的真实轨迹标签评分，类似于在 CPU profiler 评估中注入已知瓶颈，在 325 个真实会话和 4 个公开数据集上验证。
\end{enumerate}

%% ===================================================================
\section{Background and Motivation}
\label{sec:background}

\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
% AI 智能体

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。

\subsection{System Profiling}
% 系统 Profiling

Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and
tracing.
% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
and derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent trajectories do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。

\subsection{Challenges for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的挑战

Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers
by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM
traffic, but the resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。


Adapting profiling to agent trajectories faces two core challenges.
% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹面临两个核心挑战。
The first is that the responsible entities differ.
% 第一个挑战是负责实体不同。
In traditional software, profiling attributes cost to code paths, but
in agent trajectories the relevant entities are semantic categories
such as task intent and workflow phase.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 将开销归因到代码路径，但在智能体轨迹中，相关实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段）。
Existing tools do not capture these categories: sessions are
boundaries, not categories (a single session may mix review,
debugging, and refactoring phases), and span
names~\cite{otel,openinference} describe mechanisms
(\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}), not user intent
(\texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}).
% 现有工具不捕获这些类别：会话是边界而非类别（单个会话可能混合 review、debugging 和 refactoring 阶段），span 名称~\cite{otel,openinference}描述机制（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}），而非用户意图（\texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}）。
The second challenge is that agent trajectories lack the two
properties that make traditional aggregation possible:
prompts are natural language without deterministic identifiers, and
agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy.
% 第二个挑战是智能体轨迹缺乏使传统聚合成为可能的两个特性：提示词是没有确定性标识符的自然语言，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次。
As a result, a common system effect like running a test suite may
appear thousands of times across trajectories, but without semantic
tags no tool can attribute these executions to the task categories
that triggered them.
% 因此，像运行测试套件这样的常见系统副作用可能在轨迹中出现数千次，但没有语义标签，任何工具都无法将这些执行归因到触发它们的任务类别。
We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。

\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求

These observations yield three design requirements:
% 这些观察得出三个设计需求：

\begin{description}
\item[R1: Uniform record type.]
Agent activities mix prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, GUI actions, process events, and benchmark annotations.
% 智能体活动混合了提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、GUI 操作、进程事件和基准标签。
The profiler needs a single record type that can represent all of them without type-specific objects.
% 分析器需要一种能表示所有这些活动的单一记录类型，无需特定类型的对象。
\item[R2: Query-time aggregation.]
The same data must support multiple aggregation shapes (by task, phase, action, session, or dataset) without rebuilding the input.
% 同一数据必须支持多种聚合形状（按任务、阶段、操作、会话或数据集），无需重建输入。
Sessions and spans must be fields, not fixed hierarchy nodes.
% 会话和 span 必须是字段，而非固定层次节点。
\item[R3: Deterministic tags for folding.]
Free-form prompts must be mapped to short, stable, repeatable tags before folding.
% 自由形式的提示词必须在折叠前映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签。
This \emph{intent attribution} step has no analogue in CPU profiling, where function names are already deterministic.
% 这一意图归因步骤在 CPU 性能分析中没有对应物，因为函数名已经是确定性的。
\end{description}

%% ===================================================================
\section{Design}
% 设计
\label{sec:design}

The three requirements (a uniform record type, query-time aggregation, and deterministic tags for folding) drive the design.
% 三个需求（统一记录类型、查询时聚合和用于折叠的确定性标签）驱动了设计。
The semantic operation stack model has two components, operations (\S\ref{sec:ops}) and operation stacks (\S\ref{sec:stacks}), satisfying R1 and R2.
% 语义 operation stack 模型有两个组件——operation（\S\ref{sec:ops}）和 operation stack（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）——满足 R1 和 R2。
Two pluggable algorithm frameworks enrich the model. Intent attribution (\S\ref{sec:intent}) satisfies R3 by deriving deterministic tags, and stack construction (\S\ref{sec:stacks}) builds aggregation hierarchies from available fields.
% 两个可插拔算法框架丰富此模型。意图归因（\S\ref{sec:intent}）通过派生确定性标签满足 R3，栈构造（\S\ref{sec:stacks}）从可用字段构建聚合层次。
The profiling pipeline has five stages: (1)~parse raw trajectories into operations, (2)~enrich operations via intent attribution or mapping rules, (3)~filter by a user-specified predicate, (4)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (5)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
% 分析管线有五个阶段：(1) 将原始 trace 解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图归因或映射规则丰富 operation，(3) 按用户指定的谓词过滤，(4) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(5) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。

\subsection{Semantic Operation Stack Model}
% 语义 Operation Stack 模型
\label{sec:ops}

%% ¶1: Operations
Because agent activities span both the intent and system-effect
layers described in \S\ref{sec:background}, a profiler should not
distinguish between them in the data representation.
% 由于智能体活动跨越 \S\ref{sec:background} 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在数据表示层面区分它们。
\sys therefore represents every activity as a single abstraction, the
\operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive
measures.
% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。
Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project},
\texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag},
\texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain},
\texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count,
duration, occurrence count).
% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、出现次数）。
A prompt, an LLM call, a tool invocation, a file read, a GUI click,
and a process event are all operation records that differ only in
which fields are populated.
% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是 operation 记录，仅在填充的字段上有所不同。

%% ¶2: Operation Stacks
\label{sec:stacks}
An \opstack is an ordered list of fields chosen at query time.
% 一个 operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表。
Given a stack specification $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$, each
operation $o$ is projected to a frame sequence
$\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$.
% 给定栈规范 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$，每个 operation $o$ 被投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$。
Operations with identical frame sequences are merged and their
weights are summed.
% 具有相同帧序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
Unlike CPU profiling, where the call stack is determined by
execution, the stack is determined by the query.
% 与 CPU 分析中调用栈由执行决定不同，这里的栈由查询决定。
The same operations can be folded as a flat task summary, a
per-session tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a
dataset-native trajectory, and changing the fields changes the
aggregation without changing the data.
% 同一组 operation 可以折叠为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或数据集原生轨迹，改变字段即改变聚合方式而无需改变数据。
Sessions and spans are optional operation fields, not structural
skeleton nodes, so the same data supports both debugging views
(include \texttt{session}) and aggregate profiling views (exclude
it).
% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段而非结构性骨架节点，因此同一数据既支持调试视图（包含 \texttt{session}）也支持聚合 profiling 视图（排除它）。
A view is a triple $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$: a predicate
$\varphi$ selects which operations participate, a stack function
$\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ maps each operation to its frame
sequence, and a weight function $w$ assigns a nonnegative measure.
% 一个视图是三元组 $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$：谓词 $\varphi$ 选择参与的 operation，栈函数 $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation 映射到其帧序列，权重函数 $w$ 赋予非负度量。
Four built-in defaults (Table~\ref{tab:views}) answer common
questions.
% 四个内置默认视图（Table~\ref{tab:views}）回答常见问题。

\begin{table}[t]
\centering\small
\caption{Built-in views. Each shares the same operation set
but selects different activities, stack structures, and weights.}
\label{tab:views}
\begin{tabular}{llll}
\toprule
View & $\varphi$ (select) & $w$ (width) & Question \\
\midrule
\texttt{tokens} & LLM calls & token count & Budget distribution? \\
\texttt{time} & All timed ops & duration (s) & Time distribution? \\
\texttt{files} & File-effect ops & event count & Repo coverage? \\
\texttt{network} & Net-effect ops & event count & External contacts? \\

\subsection{Algorithms}
% 算法
\label{sec:intent}

\paragraph{Intent attribution.}
% 意图归因。
Intent attribution maps free-form prompts to short, stable,
deterministic tags, giving agent trajectories the stable
identifiers that traditional profiling gets for free from function
names (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 意图归因将自由形式的提示词映射为短小、稳定、确定性的标签，为智能体轨迹提供传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标识符（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
The framework supports three pluggable backends.
% 该框架支持三种可插拔后端。
Regex rules are the production default: rules have the form
\texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}, are evaluated in order (first match wins),
and the developer iterates with \sys until the unmatched rate drops
below 5\%, typically in 5--10 rounds.
% 正则规则是生产环境默认：规则格式为 \texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}，按顺序求值（首个匹配胜出），开发者与 \sys 迭代直到未匹配率降至 5\% 以下，通常需要 5--10 轮。
A local LLM tagger (e.g., a quantized 3B-parameter model via llama.cpp)
generates a single-word tag per prompt with grammar-constrained
decoding (forcing output to match a predefined token grammar) and caching.
% 本地 LLM 标注器（如通过 llama.cpp 运行的量化 3B 参数模型）通过语法约束解码（强制输出匹配预定义 token 语法）和缓存为每个提示词生成单词标签。
Unsupervised clustering via TF-IDF and K-Means discovers
natural prompt groups without predefined rules, feeding rule
authoring.
% 通过 TF-IDF 和 K-Means 的无监督聚类在没有预定义规则的情况下发现自然提示词分组，为规则编写提供输入。
For structured traces where action types and quality annotations are
explicit fields, mapping rules derive new fields from existing
ones (e.g., \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}).
% 对于操作类型和质量标注是显式字段的结构化 trace，映射规则从现有字段派生新字段（如 \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}）。
All backends are pluggable, and a profiling configuration records the
complete analysis setup for deterministic replay.
% 所有后端都是可插拔的，profiling configuration 记录完整的分析配置以实现确定性重放。

\paragraph{Stack construction.}
% 栈构造。
Stack construction builds aggregation hierarchies from
available fields.
% 栈构造从可用字段构建聚合层次。
When users supply a ordered list of fields, the projection is direct.
% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
When no chain is supplied, \sys can induce operation stacks
automatically by scoring adjacent operations for semantic shifts,
field changes, and partition coherence, then cutting at boundaries
where the evidence is strongest.
% 当不提供有序字段列表时，\sys 可以通过对相邻 operation 评分语义转移、字段变化和分区一致性来自动诱导 operation stack，然后在证据最强的边界处切分。
The induced stacks have variable depth, and a configurable depth cap
controls the granularity.
% 诱导的栈具有可变深度，可配置的深度上限控制粒度。
This mode produces coarser groups than hand-specified stacks but
requires no domain knowledge, making it useful for initial
exploration (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 此模式产生比手动指定栈更粗的分组，但不需要领域知识，适用于初始探索（\S\ref{sec:eval}）。

\section{Implementation}
% 实现
\label{sec:impl}

\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler implemented as a Rust CLI (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% \sys 是一个离线、事后分析器，实现为 Rust CLI（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
It reads recorded traces, not live events.
% 它读取记录的 trace，而非实时事件。
The \texttt{agent-session} crate reads Codex and Claude Code local JSONL history files and reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and their triggered file and network effects.
% \texttt{agent-session} crate 读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 本地 JSONL 历史文件，重建提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用及其触发的文件和网络副作用。
Each prompt opens a span.
% 每个提示词打开一个 span。
LLM calls, tool calls, and system effects within that span inherit its semantic tag, connecting intent to system behavior without runtime instrumentation.
% 该 span 内的 LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用继承其语义标签，无需运行时插桩即可连接意图与系统行为。
Public benchmark datasets enter as operation JSONL with mapping rules deriving fields before stack construction.
% 公开基准数据集以 operation JSONL 形式进入，映射规则在栈构建之前派生字段。
Standard Chrome Trace Event format can also be imported, with non-\sys protocol fields preserved as operation fields.
% 标准 Chrome Trace Event 格式也可导入，非 \sys 协议字段作为 operation 字段保留。

Output formats include pprof protobuf (compatible with \texttt{go tool pprof -http}), folded-stack text (compatible with \texttt{flamegraph.pl}), standalone SVG flame graphs, and JSON summaries.
% 输出格式包括 pprof protobuf（兼容 \texttt{go tool pprof -http}）、折叠栈文本（兼容 \texttt{flamegraph.pl}）、独立 SVG 火焰图和 JSON 摘要。
Operations can also be exported as standard Chrome Trace Event JSON and re-imported with byte-identical folded output, enabling interoperability with trace viewers such as Perfetto.
% Operation 也可以导出为标准 Chrome Trace Event JSON 并重新导入，折叠输出字节相同，支持与 Perfetto 等 trace 查看器的互操作。
All outputs are deterministic given the same input and profiling configuration.
% 在相同输入和 profiling configuration 下，所有输出都是确定性的。

\sys is the offline profiling component of the AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} observability framework.
% \sys 是 AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 可观测性框架的离线分析组件。
AgentSight provides real-time eBPF-based capture of SSL traffic, process events, and file/network effects.
% AgentSight 提供基于 eBPF 的实时 SSL 流量、进程事件和文件/网络副作用捕获。
\sys aggregates the recorded traces into semantic profiles, so the two are complementary: AgentSight answers ``what happened during this run'' (debugging), and \sys answers ``where did the budget go across runs'' (profiling).
% \sys 将记录的 trace 聚合为语义概要，因此两者互补：AgentSight 回答"这次运行发生了什么"（调试），\sys 回答"预算跨运行花在了哪里"（分析）。

\section{Evaluation}
% 评估
\label{sec:eval}

We use two classes of data.
% 我们使用两类数据。
\textbf{Real agent trajectories}: 325 readable local trajectories (198~Codex, 50~Claude, 77~Claude subagent) from a multi-month development project, containing 183{,}714 system observations.
% 真实智能体会话：来自一个多月开发项目的 325 个可读本地会话（198 个 Codex、50 个 Claude、77 个 Claude 子智能体），包含 183,714 个系统观测。
\textbf{Public annotated traces}: 15 families of real agent or human executions, totaling 47{,}590 operations through mapping rules.
% 公开标注 trace：15 个真实智能体或人类执行的家族，通过映射规则共计 47,590 个 operation。
These cover web agents (WebLINX~\cite{weblinx}, Mind2Web~\cite{mind2web}, AgentTrek~\cite{agenttrek}, WebShop~\cite{webshop}), API agents (API-Bank~\cite{apibank}, ToolBench~\cite{toolbench}, tau-bench~\cite{taubench}), coding agents (SWE-agent~\cite{sweagent}), and mobile/GUI agents (AndroidCtrl~\cite{androidcontrol}, GUI-Odyssey~\cite{guiodyssey}, ScaleCUA~\cite{scalecua}).
% 涵盖 web 智能体（WebLINX、Mind2Web、AgentTrek、WebShop）、API 智能体（API-Bank、ToolBench、tau-bench）、编码智能体（SWE-agent）和移动/GUI 智能体（AndroidCtrl、GUI-Odyssey、ScaleCUA）。
Four families with ground-truth quality annotations (AgentRewardBench~\cite{agentrewardbench}, SATraj-OS~\cite{safactory}, AgentNet~\cite{agentnet}, OSWorld-Human~\cite{osworldhuman}) provide hidden annotations for RQ2.
% 四个具有真实质量标注的家族（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet、OSWorld-Human）为 RQ2 提供隐藏标签。
We measure semantic separation via the mixed-weight percentage defined in RQ1.
% 我们通过 RQ1 中定义的混合权重百分比测量语义分离度。
For localization quality (RQ2), we use average precision (AP, the area under the precision-recall curve when groups are ranked by suspected problem density), recall at various inspection budgets, and work-to-first-positive (the fraction of groups inspected before finding one positive).
% 对于定位质量（RQ2），我们使用平均精度（AP，按疑似问题密度排序分组时精确率-召回率曲线下面积）、不同检查预算下的召回率和首个正例工作量（找到一个正例前检查的分组比例）。
For tag agreement (RQ3), we use V-measure (a clustering-agreement score ranging from 0 to 1) and boundary F1.
% 对于标签一致性（RQ3），我们使用 V-measure（聚类一致性分数，范围 0 到 1）和边界 F1。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ1: Does Semantic Profiling Improve Resource Attribution?}
% RQ1：语义分析能否改善资源归因？

The strongest argument against semantic profiling is that traditional tools ``can already see the same information.''
% 反对语义分析的最强论点是传统工具"已经能看到相同信息"。
To test this, we run a semantic-axis ablation on 325 real Codex/Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system observations).
% 为了检验这一点，我们在 325 个真实 Codex/Claude 会话（183,714 个系统观测）上进行语义轴消融。
We progressively add tag axes (no tags, session only, prompt only, both) and measure the mixed-weight percentage, the fraction of system-effect cost in groups that mix observations from multiple task categories.
% 我们逐步添加标签轴（无标签、仅会话、仅提示词、两者兼有），测量混合权重百分比——混合了多个任务类别观测的桶中的系统副作用权重比例。
A lower mixed-weight percentage means the profiler correctly separates effects by task category.
% 更低的混合权重百分比意味着分析器正确地按任务类别分离了效果。
The residual percentage measures weight in groups where the majority category accounts for less than 90\% of the group, capturing partial mixing.
% 残余百分比测量多数类别占桶内不到 90\% 的权重，捕获部分混合。

\begin{table}[t]
\centering\small
\caption{Semantic-axis ablation on 183{,}714 system observations
from 325 real trajectories. All rows preserve the same total weight.}
\label{tab:mixing}
\begin{tabular}{lrrr}
\toprule
Projection & Unique stacks & Mixed weight \% & Residual \% \\
\midrule
No semantic tags & 11{,}967 & 90.4 & 44.7 \\
Session tag only & 15{,}027 & 84.4 & 33.4 \\
Prompt tag only & 24{,}703 & 36.7 & 7.5 \\
Session + prompt & 26{,}829 & 0.0 & 0.0 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

Table~\ref{tab:mixing} shows the result on 325 real Codex/Claude trajectories.
% Table~\ref{tab:mixing} 展示了 325 个真实 Codex/Claude 会话上的结果。
Without semantic tags, 90.4\% of system-effect cost falls into mixed groups.
% 没有语义标签时，90.4\% 的系统副作用权重落入混合桶。
A flat \texttt{cargo~test} counter shows 2{,}903 executions but cannot distinguish whether they came from \texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{refactor}, or \texttt{test} prompts.
% 扁平的 \texttt{cargo test} 计数器显示 2,903 次执行，但无法区分它们来自 \texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}、\texttt{refactor} 还是 \texttt{test} 提示词。
Adding only the prompt tag reduces mixed weight to 36.7\% and residual to 7.5\%.
% 仅添加提示词标签就将混合权重降至 36.7\%，残余降至 7.5\%。
The session label alone barely helps (84.4\%), because trajectories typically contain multiple intent phases.
% 仅会话标签几乎没有帮助（84.4\%），因为会话通常包含多个意图阶段。

A label-permutation test (1{,}000 shuffles, $p = 0.001$) confirms the separation is not random.
% 标签置换测试（1,000 次洗牌，$p = 0.001$）确认分离不是随机的。
Semantic-tag quality is validated in RQ3.
% 语义标签质量在 RQ3 中验证。

Beyond label separation, we test whether choosing different field selections for the operation stack produces views that flat grouping cannot.
% 除标签分离外，我们还测试为 operation stack 选择不同字段是否产生扁平分组无法产生的视图。
We take the same 13{,}265 operations from the four oracle-rich families and fold them with five different field selections, counting how many distinct groups each produces.
% 我们取四个 oracle 丰富家族的同样 13,265 个 operation，用五种不同字段选择折叠，计算每种产生多少不同分组。
The same operations fold into 9~dataset groups, 57~phase groups, 226~semantic groups, 455~action groups, or 3{,}757~per-session groups by changing only the stack fields.

% RQ4：分析开销是多少？

% 分析开销是会话结束后花费的时间和资源。

% 我们重新执行 76 个跟踪的 profiling configuration 两次（152 次调用）来测量开销并验证确定性。

% 中位分析时间为每 spec 1.6 秒（p95 2.8 秒，最大 4.3 秒），中位输出大小为 37.5 KB。

\section{Related Work}
% 相关工作

Agent observability
tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}
focus on single-execution debugging.
% 智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,openinference,agentops,agenttelemetry,agenttraces-trust}聚焦于单次执行调试。
Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} and
Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} cluster inputs or extract signals but
characterize input distributions, not resource attribution.
% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 和 Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 聚类输入或提取信号，但刻画的是输入分布而非资源归因。
AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}, TELBench~\cite{telbench},
AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}, TrajAD~\cite{trajad}, and
AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} perform per-trajectory fault
localization.
% AgentRx~\cite{agentrx}、TELBench~\cite{telbench}、AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas}、TrajAD~\cite{trajad} 和 AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} 执行逐轨迹故障定位。
\sys complements all of these with category-level aggregate profiling
across trajectories.
